Bài mẫu

On  “vehicle-free  days,”  when  private  cars,  trucks,  and  motorcycles  are  prohibited  from  entering  the  city 

center, residents are urged to use public transportation, such as buses, taxis, and the metro. While there are 

certain disadvantages to this program, I believe the benefits exceed the drawbacks.

There are certain negative outcomes that could result from this policy. One of the most major disadvantages 

of car-free days is the inconvenience and disruption(1) they might cause to individuals who rely on private 

vehicles for transit(2). For instance, commuters(3) delivery drivers, and emergency services may struggle to 

navigate through the city center(4) and reach their destinations on time(5). Furthermore, businesses located 

in  the  city  center  which  rely  on  vehicle  traffic  for  customers(6)  may  suffer  financially  (7)  as  fewer  people 

visit their establishments(8) on vehicle-free days. As a consequence, this negative impact on businesses may 

considerably affect employment and economic activity(9) in the city.

Despite these disadvantages, there are far more(10) eadvantages to having vehicle-free days in the urban core. 

One crucial benefit is the reduction in air pollution levels. Vehicle emissions are indeed a major  source  of 

air pollution(11) in metropolitan areas(12), leading to a detrimental effect(13) on public health(14). By restricting 

vehicles in the city center, the air quality could be substantially improved, resulting in health benefits for both 

residents and visitors. Additionally, vehicle-free days can help promote sustainable transportation(15), such 

as public transit(16), cycling, and walking. Thus, individuals are inspired to adopt more environmentally friendly 

commuting habits(17), which  would result in less greenhouse gas emissions(18) and a decrease of reliance 

on fossil fuels(19). 

In conclusion, while there may be discomfort and interruption to certain individuals and businesses, the health 

and environmental benefits make vehicle-free days a worthwhile initiative(20) in the long run(21).

Bài mẫu

In some cities, vehicle-free days are implemented(1) as a way to encourage the use of public transportation 

and promote sustainable transportation(2). While this approach has both benefits and downsides, I believe the 

advantages of vehicle-free days are overshadowed by its drawbacks.

Vehicle-free days can promote physical activity and reduce traffic congestion, both of which benefit health 

and the environment. Physical inactivity(3) is a leading cause(4) of non-communicable diseases(5), such as 

heart disease, diabetes(6) and obesity(7). By increasing the use of public transportation(8), walking or cycling 

on vehicle-free days, public health(9) would be considerably benefited. Moreover, vehicle-free days can help 

alleviate(10) traffic congestion by encouraging people to use public transportation, which can ultimately cut 

down on the number of private vehicles on the road(11). By mitigating(10) traffic congestion, vehicle-free days 

can not only improve air quality(12) but also make travel faster and more efficient(13). 

However,  while  potential  benefits  do  exist,  there  are  a  host  of(14)  negative  impacts  which  stem  from(15) 

vehicle-free days. Banning private vehicles can be an inconvenience for inhabitants who need to go within 

the city center, particularly those with mobility impairments(16) or who rely on private vehicles for transit(17). 

The  inconvenience  might  be  especially  felt  by  residents  who  need  to  deliver  large  or  bulky(18)  supplies, 

such as furniture or groceries. Furthermore, vehicle-free days also appear particularly tough for those with 

impairments(19) or the elderly, who may find it difficult to carry items on public transportation or walk long 

distances.  Besides,  while  vehicle-free  days  might  play  a  role  in  promoting  sustainable  transportation(20) 

and  reducing  air  pollution,  they  may  have  limited  efficacy(21)  in  the  long  term(22).  As  a  matter  of  fact(23), 

vehicle-free days are often adopted for a limited length of time, such as one day or one weekend, which may 

not be adequate to affect people’s behavior in the long run(22).

In conclusion, while establishing vehicle-free days in city centers has both advantages and downsides, this 

approach appears to result in more detrimental impacts than its benefits.

Bài mẫu

In today’s digital age, individuals are increasingly turning to the internet as their primary source of news 

instead of conventional platforms like newspapers and TV programs. Although some argue that this trend 

might have unfavorable impacts, I believe this is a positive development.

Undoubtedly,  one  positive  aspect  of  using  the  internet  to  acquire  news  is  its  sheer  convenience(1).  In 

contrast to(2) traditional newspapers and television shows, which have restricted reach and availability(3), 

the internet allows quick and simple access to a diverse range of news sources across the world anytime, 

anywhere. With just a few clicks, we can access news articles, opinion pieces, and reports from a multitude of 

sources(4) , including mainstream media outlets(5), news websites, and social media platforms. Additionally, 

thanks to the internet, people now could tailor their news sources to match their interests(6), preferences, 

and values. For example, we can subscribe to news channels, follow journalists on social media, or utilize 

filters to curate(7) a personalized news feed, which seems not feasible to the one-size-fits-all(8) approach 

of traditional newspapers. 

Obtaining news online is not only convenient, but it is also economical and environmentally friendly. Unlike 

traditional  newspapers  and  television  programs,  which  rely  on  subscription  fees(9)   or  advertisements  to 

stay in business(10), the internet offers a wide range of free news sources, such as news websites, social 

media, and blogs. Rather than purchasing physical copies(11) of newspapers or paying for cable or satellite 

TV  subscriptions,  we  may  now  receive  news  material  online  for  free  or  at  a  fraction  of  the  cost(12). This 

not only saves us money but also reduces paper and energy consumption, thus contributing to a reduced 

carbon footprint, which in turn(13), lowers our environmental impact.  

In  conclusion,  I  believe  that  getting  news  through  the  internet  is  a  positive  development  that  has  the 

potential to greatly benefit individuals and society as a whole.

Bài mẫu

In today’s digital age, more and more people are turning to the internet for news consumption rather than 

traditional newspapers or TV programs. However , this movement is not without its consequences. From 

my perspective, this is a negative development.

While  the  internet  offers  a  plethora  of  news  sources(1),  it  has  also  facilitated  the  spread  of  fake  news 

and misinformation(2). In today’s world, anyone with a computer and an internet connection may generate 

and publish news content, regardless of its authenticity(3). Furthermore, many internet news sources lack  

editorial  oversight(4),  and  post  articles  without  sufficient  fact-checking.  As  a  consequence,  this  lack  of 

accountability has led to the expansion of sensationalist headlines and misleading content(5). For example, 

during the COVID-19 pandemic, false claims(6), about the virus’s origins and cures were widely published on 

the internet, causing confusion and panic among the general public.

The  constant  bombardment(7)  of  negative  news  on  the  internet  can  be  detrimental  to  one’s  well  being 

and mental health. The 24-hour news cycle ensures that we are never too far away from breaking news, 

but  it  also  means  that  unpleasant  news  stories  are  amplified(8)  and  replayed  constantly,  instilling  fear 

and  anxiety.  Furthermore,  the  potential  of  addiction  and  overconsumption  is  also  a  major  concern,  with 

numerous individuals spending excessive amounts of time on their screens(9) consuming articles. This can 

lead to feelings of overwhelm (10), anxiety(11), and exhaustion(12), all of which are harmful to one’s emotional 

and  mental  well-being.  What  is  more,  online  news  has  been  shown  to  amplify  anxiety  and  depression, 

particularly among those who are already dealing with mental health issues. Thus, constant exposure to 

negative news(13) can develop a sense of hopelessness and despair(14), that can be challenging to overcome.

In conclusion, while the internet may offer accessibility and convenience, the risks of misleading news and 

its detrimental effects on mental health can represent a negative development.

(308 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

Phân tích từ vựng

1.  a plethora of news sources: đa dạng các nguồn thông tin

•  a plethora of ~ a wide variety of ~ a wide range of something: đa dạng, rất nhiều

2.  misinformation (n): sự sai lệch thông tin, thông tin sai sự thật

3.  regardless of its authenticity: mặc cho tính xác thực của thông tin

•  regardless of something: bất chấp, mặc cho cái gì

4.  editorial oversight: giám sát từ khâu biên tập

5.  misleading content: nội dung điều hướng sai lệch

6.  false claims: những khẳng định thiếu xác đáng

7.  bombardment (n): sự tiếp xúc liên tục, thường xuyên với số lượng nhiều

8.  amplify (v): phóng đại, nâng sức ảnh hưởng

•  Ex: A funeral can amplify the feelings of regret and loss for the relatives.

9.  spending excessive amounts of time on their screens: dành thời gian quá nhiều với thiết bị điện tử

10. overwhelm (n): sự quá tải

11. anxiety (n): cảm giác lo âu

•  exposure to something: sự tiếp xúc với cái gì

14. a sense of hopelessness and despair: cảm giác tuyệt vọng và bất lực, chán nản

Bài mẫu 1: Thiếu niên nên học đều tất cả các môn học

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: Thiếu niên nên học đều tất cả các môn học.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Lợi ích của việc học chọn lọc theo sở thích.

•  Học theo sở thích thể hiện sự tôn trọng quyền tự do cá nhân.

•  Thiếu niên thường tập trung hơn đối với những môn học ưa thích, từ đó 

có kết quả tốt hơn.

•  Đam  mê  học  tập  về  lâu  dài  giúp  mang  đến  nhiều  lợi  ích  đáng  kể  cho

Đoạn 2: Thiếu niên nên học đều tất cả các môn học.

•  Học  các  môn  khác  nhau  giúp  học  sinh  xác  định  được  điểm  mạnh  và 

điểm yếu của mình.

•  Việc học đều các môn mang lại tầm nhìn bao quát hơn về thế giới và hiểu 

biết đa khía cạnh, điều này đóng vai trò quan trọng trong xã hội toàn cầu 

hóa ngày nay.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài.

Bài mẫu

Some individuals suggest that teenagers should give equal attention to all subjects, while others argue that 

they should prioritize the subjects that they find most engaging. While there are advantages to both views, 

I believe that teenagers should focus on all subjects equally.

On the one hand, allowing students to decide what they want to learn shows respect for individual freedom(1), 

and therefore leads to greater engagement and understanding of the subject(2). When a topic piques their 

interest(3), teenagers are more likely to engage with the material(4) and achieve a deeper grasp(5) as well as 

better academic performance. For instance, a student with a strong interest in literature is inclined to read 

more  books(6),  analyze  them  in  detail(7),  and  perhaps  even  compose  essays  on  the  topics  they  raise.  Such 

interest  and  enthusiasm  can blossom  into(8)  a  lifelong  passion  for  learning,  which  will  undoubtedly  bring 

about far-reaching(9) advantages in a person’s life.

While it is essential for young people to be permitted to pursue their interests, it is also necessary for them 

to receive a well-rounded education(10). Studying multiple courses can help students identify their strengths 

and weaknesses, enabling them to pursue future education and career prospects that match their interests 

and  abilities(11).  For  instance,  a  student  who  succeeds  in  math  and  physics  could  develop  a  passion  for 

engineering  or  technology,  whereas  a  student  who  excels  in(12)  languages  and  social  sciences  might 

discover a calling in law or public service(13). Additionally, a well-rounded education may assist young people 

develop  a  broader  perspective  on  the  world(14),  leading  to  better  empathy  and  understanding  for  various 

perspectives. This is particularly essential in today’s globalized society, where cross-cultural communication 

and cooperation(15) are becoming increasingly critical. 

In  conclusion,  although  there  are  reasonable  arguments  on  both  sides  of  the  debate,  I  believe  that  young 

people should devote equal time to all subjects.

(305 words)

Bài mẫu

While some argue that young people should pay equal attention to each subject, others believe that they 

ought  to  concentrate  solely  on  the  subjects  that  they  find  intriguing. Teenagers,  in  my  opinion,  ought  to 

prioritize mainly on topics that they find captivating.

On  the  one  hand,  it’s  crucial  that  teenagers  devote(1)  equal  time  to  each  academic  area.  Students  who 

receive a comprehensive education(2) are more inclined to(3) be empathetic and develop better awareness 

of  different  viewpoints.  For  example,  studying  history  enables  students  to  appreciate  the  hardships  and 

achievements(4)  of  people  from  many  cultures  and  backgrounds,  whereas  studying  science  can  help 

learners  grasp(5)  the  impact  of  technology  on  society.  Moreover,  a  well-rounded  education(6),  also  helps 

young  people  prepare  themselves  for  many  difficulties  and  circumstances  they  might  run  across(7) later 

on(8).  By  gaining  knowledge  and  skills  in  different  subjects,  students  are  better  equipped  to  face  the 

demands of higher education, the workforce, and their personal lives.

On the other hand, it is critical for teenagers to focus primarily on subjects that they find intriguing. Focusing 

on topics that piques students’ interest(9) enhances their retention and comprehension(10) of the content, 

resulting  in  a  deeper  understanding  of  the  material  and  higher  academic  performance.  What  is  more, 

concentrating on areas of strength(11) can help build self-confidence and lead to greater success. In other 

words, gaining mastery in an area of study gives young learners a sense of pride and encourages them to 

keep up their performance(12). Besides, one’s time and effort would be better spent pursuing passions or 

developing abilities in areas of interest rather than on dull subjects. If a student has an aptitude for art(13) 

but is struggling in math, it may be more beneficial for them to spend extra time in art class or partake in 

extracurricular activities related to art.

Bài mẫu

In addition to offering formal education, it is generally believed that schools have a duty to teach students 

proper behaviour. While schools may play a part in(1) promoting appropriate behaviour, it is ultimately the 

responsibility of parents and professionals to reinforce these values for children. 

To  some  extent(2),  schools  should  be  in  charge  of(3)  training  proper  behaviour.  As  most  children  spend 

an  excessive  amount  of  time  in  school,  surrounded  by  peers  and  teachers(4),  it  stands  to  reason  that(5) 

schools  have  a  significant  impact  on  them. Thus,  it makes  sense(6)  to  charge  these  institutions  with  the 

responsibility  of  fostering  good  behaviour  among  their  children.  Additionally,  when  schools  prioritise 

positive  behaviour,  it  can  assist  in  mitigating(7)  bullying,  aggression,  and  other  inappropriate  behaviours 

that pose  a  threat  to  students’  mental  health  and  well-being(8). Ultimately,  this  approach  would  not only 

help establish a welcoming and secure environment but also give rise to better academic performance(9).

While teachers have a role to play in shaping students’ character(10), it is ultimately the duty of parents and 

other adults to instill core values(11) among children. Although it is true that schools strive to make students 

become  well-rounded  individuals(12),  it’s  also  the  case  that(13)  young  people  need  to  learn  about  values, 

ethics,  and  social  norms(13) from their own families. Besides, schools may not always be the most ideal 

environment to reinforce proper behaviour. For example, if a child is suffering from trauma, stress, or other 

mental health issues, they may require specialised care that goes beyond what a school can provide(14). As 

a result, it could be preferable for schools to collaborate with families and mental health professionals to 

ensure that children receive the necessary care.

Bài mẫu

The given diagram illustrates the process of aluminium cans recycling.

Overall, the aluminium cans recycling process  includes five key stages(1), beginning with(2) the gathering 

of discarded cans and ending with(3) newly recycled products.

In the first stage, used cans are collected from various sources in preparation for the recycling procedure. 

Once  the  cans  are  gathered(4),  they  are  then  transported  to  a  processing  facility  where  they  undergo 

cleaning,  sorting,  shredding,  and  compressing  into  small  portions.  Following  that(5),  these  processed 

cans  are  then  heated  to  extremely  high  temperatures  and  melted  to  form  liquid  aluminium,  preparing 

them for the following phases.

After being heated, the aluminium is solidified and flattened into individual rolls that range in thickness 

from 2.5 to 6 mm(6). In the last stage, these rolls are then utilised to produce new aluminium cans, which 

are finally distributed back for reuse(7). It is noteworthy that recycled cans account for 74% of the total 

amount(8) of aluminium cans in the UK.

(160 words)

Bài mẫu

When  it  comes  to  crime  rates,  some  individuals  claim  that  criminal  activity  is  solely  the  result  of  innate 

characteristics(1), while others argue that it is the outcome of societal issues and impoverishment. In my opinion, 

socioeconomic challenges(2) and inequality are more likely to prompt people to engage in illegal behaviours(3).

On  the  one  hand,  criminality  could  represent  the  result  of  an  inherent  personality(1).  In  some  cases,  crime 

is  merely  the  result  of  a  person’s  impulsive  actions  and  lack  of  moral  compass(4).  Various  factors  such  as 

upbringing, personal beliefs, and psychological disorders may all play a role(5) when it comes to criminal activity. 

Some people, for example, may have grown up in environments in which illegal conduct is normalised, causing 

them to assume that such behaviour is acceptable. Similarly, those with mental health disorders like sociopathy 

or psychopathy may be inclined to committing crimes(6) due to their inability to empathise with victims.

On the other hand, societal problems and economic hardship may contribute to criminal conduct. Poverty with 

limited access to food, clothing, shelter, healthcare, and schooling can push people to the brink of desperation(7), 

prompting them to resort to criminal behaviour as a means of survival(8). People who are financially strapped(9) 

in various urban areas, for instance, may turn to illegal activities(8) like drug trafficking(10) or burglaries in order 

to make ends meet(11). Once poverty and crime are intertwined, it may ultimately develop into a vicious cycle(12) 

that  is  challenging  to  escape.  Furthermore,  socioeconomic  issues  such  as  discrimination,  inequality,  and 

corruption(13)  may  promote  crime  through  fostering  an  environment  of  dissatisfaction  and  rage.  Those  who 

experience discrimination or who believe the system is stacked against them(14) are more inclined to turn to 

illegal behaviour as a form of protest or vengeance. 

To summarise, aside from personal psychological factors, I believe that social difficulties and poverty can have 

a greater impact on crime rates. 

(312 words)

Bài mẫu

When  it  comes  to  crime  rates,  some  individuals  claim  that  criminal  activity  is  solely  the  result  of  innate 

characteristics(1), while others argue that it is the outcome of societal issues and impoverishment. In my opinion, 

inherent personality is more likely to prompt people to engage in illegal behaviours(2).

On the one hand, criminality could represent the result of societal problems and economic hardship. Poverty 

with  inadequate  access  to  food,  clothing,  shelter,  healthcare,  and  schooling  can  push  people  to  the  brink 

of  desperation(3),  prompting  them  to  resort  to  criminal  behaviour  as  a  means  of  survival(4).  People  who  are 

financially strapped(5) in various urban areas, for instance, may turn to(4) illegal activities like drug trafficking(6) 

or  burglaries  in  order  to  make  ends  meet(7).  Furthermore,  socioeconomic  issues(8)  such  as  discrimination, 

inequality,  and  corruption  may  promote  crime  through  fostering  an  environment  of  dissatisfaction  and  rage. 

Those who experience discrimination or who believe the system is stacked against them(9) are more inclined to 

turn to illegal behaviour as a form of protest or vengeance.

On  the  other  hand,  personal  nature  may  contribute  to  criminal  conduct.  Due  to  their  family’s  history,  certain 

people may be genetically predisposed to violent or criminal behaviour(10), Additionally, early trauma, abuse, 

or  neglect  can  result  in  a  distorted  sense  of  self  and  poor  emotional  regulation(11),  which  raises  the  risk  of 

illegal activity in later life(12). In some cases, individuals may also be exposed to(13) violence or illegal conduct 

from  a  young  age,  normalising  it  as  a  form  of  common  behaviour(14)  and  increasing  the  likelihood  that  they 

would  partake  in  such  activities  themselves.  Similarly,  those  with  mental  health  disorders  like  sociopathy  or 

psychopathy may be inclined to committing crimes(15) due to their inability to empathise with victims.

To summarise, aside from social difficulties and poverty, I believe that personal psychological factors can have 

a greater impact on crime rates.  

(298 words)

In the summer, the number of visitors soared/surged(3), from 9 to 12 o’clock in the morning, peaking at

was a considerable rise in visitor numbers between 9 and 12 o’clock, with a high of 600 in the middle of

Bài mẫu 1: Cả 2 bên đều nên hợp tác giảm thiểu bao bì sản phẩm

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: cả nhà sản xuất, siêu thị và người tiêu dùng đều phải

Đoạn 1: Việc đặt trách nhiệm giảm thiểu bao bì đóng gói hàng hóa lên các nhà sản

•  Điều này chủ yếu là do họ là những người sử dụng vật liệu đóng gói dư thừa 

trong sản xuất hàng loạt của họ ngay từ đầu, và tệ hơn nữa, họ có xu hướng ưu 

tiên vật liệu nguyên chất cho quy trình như vậy để giảm chi phí sản xuất.

•  Điều này đã dẫn đến vô số bãi rác hầu hết chứa chất thải không thể phân hủy 

sinh học, gây ra mối đe dọa môi trường nghiêm trọng. 

Đoạn 2: Việc cắt giảm bao bì cũng đòi hỏi phải thay đổi thói quen mua sắm của người 

tiêu dùng.

•  Do bao bì đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc thu hút sự chú ý của khách hàng 

nên các nhà sản xuất và siêu thị thường không sẵn lòng hoặc do dự áp dụng 

bao bì thân thiện với môi trường, một thực tế có thể ảnh hưởng xấu đến sự vẻ 

bề ngoài hấp dẫn của sản phẩm và nói rộng ra là doanh số bán hàng của họ.

•  Do đó, nếu người tiêu dùng chuyển sang các sản phẩm có bao bì xanh, các nhà 

sản xuất và bán lẻ sẽ bị áp lực phải cải cách chính sách bao bì của họ.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài.

Bài mẫu

WhThere are widely differing views on whether producers and retailers or consumers should be responsible 

for curtailing(1) the over-packaging of products. From my perspective, curbing excessive(2) product packaging 

necessitates a collective effort(3) from both the supply and demand sides.

On the one hand, it is reasonable to place the responsibility of minimizing goods packaging on manufacturers 

and supermarkets. This is mainly because they are those who use redundant  packaging  materials(4) in their 

mass production in the first place, and worse still, they tend to favor virgin material for such a process so as 

to reduce manufacturing overheads(5). This has resulted in innumerable landfill sites mostly containing non-

biodegradable waste(6), posing a serious environmental threat. Thus, it is up to producers and retail chains to 

adopt more  environmentally-friendly practices(7) in order to rectify this situation.

On  the  other  hand,  cutting  back  on  packaging  also  warrants  a  shift  in  consumers’  shopping  habits(8).  As 

packaging  plays  an  important  role  in(9),  attracting  customers’  attention,  manufacturers  and  supermarkets 

are  often  unwilling  or  hesitant  to  adopt  eco-friendly  packaging(10),  a  practice  that  could  adversely  affect  the 

visual  appeal  of  their  products  and,  by  extension,  their  sales  figures(11).  Therefore,  if  consumers  convert  to 

products with green packaging(10) , producers and retailers would be pressured into reforming their packaging 

policies. This can be seen in the case of Kinh Do, a confectionery corporation, which has recently decided to 

do away with unnecessary plastic ornaments(12) and switch to paper bags as a result of their growing group of  

environmentally conscious(13) patrons.

Bài mẫu

Sports sponsorship(1) has become a popular marketing tool used by companies to advertise their brand to a 

wider audience. While some people view it as a beneficial trend(2) for the world of sports, others are concerned 

about its downsides(3). This essay will examine both perspectives before concluding that I am in favor of(4) the 

former.

On  the  one  hand,  it  is  understandable  why  some  argue  that  there  are  several  disadvantages(3)  associated 

with  companies  sponsoring  sports.  Chief  among  them  is  the  potential  for  the  sport  to  become  overly 

commercialized(5), prioritizing financial gain(7) over the core values(8) and traditions of the sport. Consequently, 

the integrity(9) of the sport may suffer. To illustrate, the recent commercialization of the FIFA World Cup, the 

most prestigious(10) football tournament, has led to an emphasis on profits and marketing rather than the sport’s 

traditions and values. The tournament’s governing body, FIFA, has faced criticism(11) for accepting sponsorships 

from corporations with a history of violating human rights(12), causing doubts about the event’s genuineness(13). 

On the other hand, I side with those who claim that business sponsorship in sports has a positive impact on 

the sports sector. Firstly, sponsorship provides much-needed financial support(14) to sports teams and events, 

which can help them improve facilities and equipment for athletes. For example, the multi-million-dollar deals 

between Adidas and Manchester United have allowed the club to provide their football players with a  state-

of-the-art  gym  center(15)  and  cutting-edge  training  facilities(16).  Secondly,  sponsorship  can  increase  the 

popularity and visibility of sports, attracting more fans and media coverage. This can lead to greater exposure 

for athletes(17) and teams, enabling them to reach a broader audience. 

In conclusion, although there are valid concerns regarding the risk of sports being excessively commercialised(18), 

I feel that corporate sponsorship in sports is advantageous overall, given that it can offer crucial financial aid(19) 

to enhance sports amenities for athletes and boost the popularity and exposure of sports.

(317 words)

Sponsoring sports has become a popular means of advertising for numerous companies nowadays. While 

some view it as beneficial, others argue that it can have negative consequences(1) for the sports world. This 

essay will examine both perspectives before concluding that I am in favor of the latter.

On  the  one  hand,  it  is  understandable  why  some  argue  that  business  sponsorship(2)  fin  sports  has  positive 

impacts(3) on the sports sector. The primary reason is that such sponsorship offers crucial financial assistance 

to sports events and teams, which can enable them to upgrade(4) their equipment and facilities for athletes. For 

instance, the collaboration(5) between Manchester United and Adidas, worth millions of dollars, has enabled the 

club to provide its football players with an advanced gym center and innovative training amenities. Additionally, 

sponsorship has the potential to enhance the prominence(6) and publicity of sports, drawing in(7) more fans and 

media attention(8). Thus, athletes and teams can enjoy greater exposure, enabling them to Thus, athletes and 

teams can enjoy greater exposure, enabling them to(9). 

On  the  other  hand,  I  side  with  those  who  claim  that  the  trend  towards  companies  sponsoring  sports  is 

disadvantageous for the sports industry. One major downside of this practice is that it can result in the excessive 

commercialization(10) of sports, with companies prioritizing their own financial gain over the core values and 

integrity of sports. This can lead to criticism and a loss of prestige(11) for sports, as fans and athletes may feel 

that the purity and genuineness of sports are being compromised. For example, the European Super League, 

a  proposed  competition  involving  top  European  football  clubs,  aimed  to  generate  more  revenue(12)  through 

sponsorship  and  broadcasting  rights(13)  but  faced  severe  backlash(14)  from  fans,  athletes,  and  governments, 

leading to the withdrawal of all six English clubs involved within days of its announcement.

In conclusion, although there are legitimate justifications for advocating the notion(15) of corporate sponsorship 

in the world of sports, I would argue that this is a negative development because it could give rise to the sport 

being overly commercialized(16).

The  line  graph  illustrates  how  many  foreign  visitors(1)  came  to  the  UK  for  three  specific  reasons  from 

1989 to 2009.

Overall, there was an increase in the total number of overseas tourists(1) visiting the UK, with the purpose 

of taking a holiday(2) being the most common throughout the period, whereas the opposite was true in the 

case of meeting friends or relatives.

The  number  of  those  holidaying(2)  in  the  UK  consistently  remained  the  highest,  standing  at  just  over  6 

million  visitors  in  1989,  and  then  rising  sharply  to  reach  a  peak  of(3)  nearly  10  million  in  1999.  Despite 

dropping gradually(4) to just under 8 million five years later, this figure went up again to end the period at 

approximately 9 million.

Between 1989 and 1994, the number of overseas visitors(1) taking a business trip to the UK went from 

around 5.5 million to 4 million. Thereafter, this number climbed significantly(5) and reached its highest 

point  of(3)  8  million  in  2007,  followed  by  a  fall  of  roughly  1  million  in  the  final  year.  Visits  to  friends  or 

relatives followed a similar upward trend(6), beginning at close to 4 million visitors, growing steadily(4) to 

hit a high of(3) around 7 million in 2004, then declining to just over 6 million at the end of the timeframe.

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa  ra  quan  điểm  cá  nhân: việc  giám  đốc  của  các  tổ  chức  lớn kiếm được  mức 

lương cao hơn nhiều so với nhân viên bình thường là một điều cần thiết. 

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Giải thích tại sao một số người cho rằng việc giám đốc của các tổ chức lớn 

kiếm được mức lương cao hơn nhiều so với nhân viên bình thường là một điều không 

công bằng: 

•  Cơ cấu trả lương này không phản ánh được giá trị mà mỗi nhân viên mang 

lại cho tổ chức, do đó tạo ra cảm giác không công bằng giữa các nhân viên 

cấp dưới.

•  Đưa ra ví dụ về sự khác biệt về lương của CEO và nhân viên của Amazon để 

chứng mình luận điểm trên.

Đoạn 2: Đồng ý với những người cho rằng việc giám đốc của các tổ chức lớn kiếm 

được mức lương cao hơn nhiều so với nhân viên bình thường là một điều cần thiết. 

•  Những cá nhân này chịu các trách nhiệm quan trọng và có quyền ra quyết 

định sự thành bại của một tổ chức, và khoản tiền lương của họ phải tương 

xứng với điều này.

•  Đưa ra ví dụ về CEO của Apple để chứng minh luận điểm trên.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

There  are  widely  differing  views  on  whether  directors  of  big  corporations(1)  should  receive  significantly 

more remuneration compared to regular workers, with some individuals arguing that it is a necessity while 

others deem it inequitable(2). The following essay will thoroughly discuss both viewpoints.

On  the  one  hand,  it  is  understandable  why  some  claim  that  it  is  not  fair(2)  for  large  companies(1)  to  pay 

their managers(3) considerably more than ordinary staff members. The key rationale here is that this pay 

structure(4) fails to reflect the value each employee brings to the organisation, hence a sense of unfairness(2) 

among  lower-level  employees.  For  instance,  at  Amazon,  warehouse  workers  who  handle  and  process 

orders for the company are vital to the company’s operations, yet they are paid significantly less than the 

company’s CEO(3), Jeff Bezos, one of the richest entrepreneurs(5) in the world. As a result, this has caused 

a feeling of inequity(2) among these workers.

On  the  other  hand,  I  agree  with  those  who  believe  that  it  is  necessary  for  those  in  charge  of(3)  sizable 

organisations(1) to earn more money than their subordinates. Such individuals bear significant responsibilities 

and  decision-making  power(6)  that  can  make  or  break(7)  an  organization’s  ability  to  achieve  its  business

Mã đơn hàng: Z021241122 | Phone: 0963758090 | Email: thaykienchuyenanh@gmail.com

objectives,  and  therefore  their  compensation(8)  should  reflect  this.  For  example,  the  CEO  of  Apple,  Tim 

Cook, earns a high salary, a bonus, and stock options. Still, his leadership has overseen(9) significant growth 

and innovation in the company, making it one of the most valuable in the world. Thus, the argument is that 

handsome salaries for directors of large organisations(1) are necessary to attract and retain top talent and 

incentivize them to work towards the company’s success.

In conclusion, although there are those who think that it is unjust(2) when the directors of major corporations(1) 

is paid substantially more money than their normal employees, I am convinced that this pay disparity(10) is 

justifiable and essential for the development of these businesses.

There  is  much  debate  surrounding  whether  directors  of  large  corporations  should  be  paid  significantly 

more than regular workers(1), with some advocating for it as a necessity, while others see it as unjust. This 

essay will examine both perspectives before ultimately expressing support for the latter.

On the one hand, it is understandable why some claim that it is justifiable for directors to receive higher 

salaries  than  their  lower-level  employees(1).  This  is  due  to  the  significant  responsibilities  and  decision-

making power they hold, which can greatly affect the success or failure of the organization, and thus their 

compensation should be commensurate(2) with this level of contribution. To illustrate, the CEO of Amazon, 

Jeff Bezos, is one of the highest-paid executives globally, with a net worth of over $100 billion. However, 

he has been instrumental in(3) leading Amazon’s rapid expansion and diversification into various sectors, 

making it one of the most valuable companies in the world today.This is why many believe his higher salary 

compared to regular staff members(1) is justified(4).

On the other hand, I agree with those who believe that paying managers significantly more than ordinary 

workers(1) in large companies is inequitable. The major reason for this thinking is that it can increase income

inequality(5) and create a sense of entitlement among the privileged few(6) Jin top positions. Consequently,

corporation to be paid substantially more money than their normal employees(1), I am convinced that this 

pay disparity is not fair, and can potentially hinder the development of(12) a big company.

Turning to categories with a downward trend, households with 3 and 4 occupants witnessed the same level

thường ngày.

Bài mẫu

Advertising  has  become  a  ubiquitous  presence(1)  in  modern  society,  infiltrating  our  daily  lives  through 

television, social media, and public spaces. In my view, this is a negative development.

One of the main negative effects of advertising is its potential to invade personal privacy(2), Advertisers often 

collect personal data(3) from consumers without their knowledge or consent(4), then use this information 

to tailor their advertisements. For example, social media platforms(5) such as Facebook or Instagram, are 

believed  to  track(6)  user  activity  and  browsing  history  to  serve  up  targeted  adverts.  This  is  alarming,  as  it 

means that our online behavior is being closely monitored(7) analyzed, and exploited by companies. The more 

advertising pervades(8) our lives, the less privacy we are likely to have.

Another issue with the omnipresence of commercials(9) is that they tend to disrupt(10) our daily routines by 

acquiring our attention, making it difficult for us to focus on tasks or activities. For example, when watching 

a video on YouTube, viewers are often interrupted(11) by adverts that cannot be skipped, causing a break in 

concentration(12) and immersion. Similarly, while browsing a website or using an app, pop-up ads(13) can appear 

out of nowhere, hindering(14) navigation and frustrating users. Moreover, advertisements are often designed 

to be attention-grabbing, using bright colors and loud sounds, which can be annoying and overwhelming for 

viewers. These examples demonstrate how intrusive(15) and disruptive advertisements can become.

In conclusion, I am convinced that the increasing prevalence of(16) advertising in everyday life is a negative 

development, given its intrusive and disruptive nature and potential violation of personal privacy.

(258 words)

7.  to be closely monitored: được giám sát chặt chẽ

•  E.g: Employees may be closely monitored by their employers through the use of surveillance cameras or 

computer monitoring software.

8.  pervade: lan tràn, tràn ngập

•  E.g: Technology pervades nearly every aspect of modern life, from communication to entertainment to work.

9.  the omnipresence of commercials: sự hiện diện ở mọi nơi của quảng cáo

10. disrupt: gây gián đoạn

•  E.g: Phone calls and text messages can interrupt a person’s concentration and disrupt their work.

phần mềm nào đó

14. hinder: cản trở 

•  E.g: Lack of access to resources can hinder a person’s ability to achieve their goals.

Bài mẫu

Advertising has become an increasingly ubiquitous presence in our daily lives. Whether it is on TV, social 

media,  or  in  the  street,  we  are  often  met  with(1)  advertisements  everywhere  we  go.  In  my  opinion,  the 

increasing prevalence of advertisements is a beneficial development overall.

One  of  the  primary  benefits  of  advertising  is  that  it  can  provide  valuable  product  information(2)  to 

consumers,  prompting(3) them to(3) make better buying decisions. Specifically, with so many products and 

services  available,  making  informed  decisions(4)  without  guidance  can  be  overwhelming,  but  thanks  to 

the  widespread  appearance  of(5)  advertisements,  customers  nowadays  can  easily  decide  which  item  is 

most  suitable  for  them.  For  example,  if  someone  is  in  the  market  for  a  new  car,  they  can  quickly  and 

effortlessly  learn  about  the  latest  models(6),  features,  and  prices  through  car  adverts  shown  on  various 

forms of media, namely TV, social networks, and online newspapers. The availability of such information 

can help consumers make informed choices(4) and find the best product for their needs.

Another significant benefit of advertisements becoming more prevalent (7) is their ability to help businesses 

reach more customers(8) and increase their sales figures. With the rise of digital advertising(9), companies 

can target specific groups of people based on their interests and behaviours, resulting in more effective 

advertising  campaigns(10).  For  instance,  social  media  platforms  like  Facebook  and  Instagram  allow 

businesses  to  target  specific  demographics(11)  and  interests,  making  it  easier  for  them  to  build  up  their 

customer base(12) and generate more profits(13) as a result.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that the increasing ubiquity(14) of advertising is a positive development in our 

lives, as it enables consumers to make wiser purchasing decisions and businesses to earn more revenue(13).

The two maps illustrate the degree to which a school campus(1) has changed since 1985.

Overall,  the  school  has  experienced  significant  changes  to  accommodate(2)  the  growing  number  of 

students, the most notable of which are additional(3) classrooms and the construction(4) of various sports 

and educational facilities(5).

In 1985, around 1500 students attended(6) the school, which consisted of(7) two classroom buildings, a 

library, and the school’s office. An access road ran around a large rectangular(8) car park that lay adjacent 

to(9) the main road. A second, much smaller car park was situated(10) next to the library and one of the 

classroom buildings. The access road also led to a large playing field at the rear(11) of the school.

Presently, the school’s student population is approximately 2300. While the office remains the same, the 

library building has been reduced in size and is now a learning resources center, including a computer 

room. Furthermore, two new classroom buildings have been constructed, along with a third story(12) added 

to the existing two-story classroom block. The large playing field at the rear of the school grounds(13) has 

also been made significantly smaller to make way fort(14) a new pool and fitness center.

Đoạn 1: Các tác hại

•  Giao tiếp qua màn hình và văn bản khiến mức độ phong phú và chiều sâu

Bài mẫu

The increasing prevalence(1) of social media platforms(2) like Facebook and Twitter has led to a shift(3) in 

the way people communicate, with face-to-face contact being replaced in many aspects of everyday life. In 

my opinion, this phenomenon, despite being somewhat disadvantageous, can bring about more significant 

benefits.

The reliance(4) on social media for communication is indeed associated with certain disadvantages. One 

of  these  is  that  since  people  primarily  communicate  through  screens  and  text,  the  richness  and  depth 

of  face-to-face  interactions  diminish(5).  Non-verbal  cues(6)  and  subtle  expressions,  which  are  crucial  for 

effective communication(7), can be lost in online interactions(8). For example, humor or sarcasm(9) can be 

easily misinterpreted without visual and auditory(10) cues. This limitation in conveying emotions and intent 

through social media can result in misunderstandings(11) and strained relationships, hence undermining(12) 

the  quality  of  interpersonal  connections.  Another  problem  worth  mentioning  is  that  given  the  addictive 

nature(13)  of  social  media,  some  individuals  may  become  overly  reliant  on  virtual  interactions,  leading  to 

decreased real-world social engagement. As a result, these people may experience feelings of isolation(14), 

disconnection,  and  a  lack  of  genuine  human  connection(15),  which  can  negatively  impact(16)  their  mental 

well-being.

Nevertheless,  the  tendency  towards  utilizing  social  networks  for  communication  is  more  advantageous 

overall. The first reason is that as social media platforms offer instant and convenient connectivity, they 

enable users to bridge geographical barriers(17) and maintain relationships across distances. For instance, 

by using Facebook Messenger, individuals can stay connected with friends and family who live in different 

countries,  fostering  a  sense  of  belonging(18)  and  preserving  relationships  that  might  have  otherwise 

faded(19). Furthermore, social networking sites allow for the dissemination(20) of information and ideas on 

a global scale, facilitating social activism(21). This is because it empowers marginalized individuals(22) to 

voice their opinions(23), raise awareness about important social issues(24), thereby driving positive changes 

in society. To illustrate, Facebook and Twitter have played a crucial role in raising awareness about social 

injustices and mobilizing movements such as #MeToo and Black Lives Matter.

In conclusion, while the growing reliance on social media for communication comes with certain drawbacks, 

such as a potential decrease in the depth of interpersonal connections and a risk of social isolation, I am 

convinced that the merits of this trend, namely instant connectivity across distances and the facilitation(25) 

of social activism, are weightier.

Bài mẫu

The increasing prevalence of social media platforms such as Facebook and Twitter has resulted in a shift 

away from(1) in-person interactions in many people’s daily lives. In my opinion, this phenomenon, despite 

having some advantages, is associated with more prominent(2) drawbacks.

The  increased  use  of  social  media  for  everyday  conversations  is  beneficial  to  some  extent.  Firstly, 

since  these  platforms  offer  instant  connectivity(3),  they  allow  individuals  to  easily stay  connected  with(4) 

friends  and  family  regardless  of(5)  geographical  distance.  For  example,  by  using  Facebook  Messenger, 

someone  living  abroad  can  maintain  regular  contact  with  loved  ones(6)  back  home,  fostering  a  sense  of 

connection  and  overcoming  physical  barriers.  This  convenience  and  accessibility  enhance  relationships 

and strengthen social bonds(7). Secondly, social media platforms like Reddit and Facebook groups foster 

specialized communities(8) where users can join discussions, seek advice, and share experiences centered 

around  specific  interests,  hobbies,  or  professions.  Whether  it  is  fitness,  cooking,  or  entrepreneurship(9), 

these virtual gathering places allow individuals to connect with like-minded(10) people, leading to valuable 

connections, companionship(11), and potential collaborations(12) or mentorship(13) opportunities.

Nevertheless,  the  inclination(14)  towards  replacing  face-to-face  contact  with  social  media  is  more

is a loss of genuine human connection. The absence of face-to-face contact diminishes important aspects

and  misinterpretations(18).  For  instance,  the  absence  of  tone  or  facial  expressions(19)  in  a  text  message

the depth and authenticity of relationships, hindering meaningful connections. Furthermore, excessive(22) 

reliance  on  social  media  can  lead  to  social  isolation  and  decreased  real-world  social  engagement(23). 

People may retreat into the digital world(24), neglecting opportunities for genuine interpersonal interactions, 

and therefore the quality of relationships and emotional well-being may be negatively impacted.

In conclusion, while using social media as a substitution for face-to-face conversations offers certain merits, 

such as facilitating long-distance communication and building specialized communities, the negatives of 

such a trend, including the loss of genuine human connection and the risk(25) of social isolation, are more 

pronounced(26).

Bài mẫu

The line graph shows how much bananas cost in four different nations from 1994 to 2004.

Overall, banana prices in all countries experienced wild fluctuations(1), except for the USA, whose figure 

remained  relatively  stable(2)  for  the  majority  of(3)  the  period.  Additionally,  bananas  were  generally  the 

most and least expensive in Japan and the USA, respectively.

Regading Japan, the cost of a kilogram of bananas started at nearly 2 US dollars, after which it had risen 

sharply to peak at(4) around 2.8 by 1995. Despite an increase between 1997 and 1999, the banana price 

in Japan dropped to a low of just above 1.5 US dollars per kilogram before rebounding(5) to end at 2.5. 

Bananas in the USA, meanwhile, were initially priced at(6) about 0.7 US dollars. This was followed by a rise 

to approximately 1.1 one year later and a leveling off(7) towards the end of the timeframe.

Turning to France, there was a period of stability(8) in the price of bananas, remaining at roughly 1.7 US 

dollars per kilogram from 1994 to 1997. Thereafter, the figure fluctuated wildly(9), with it becoming the 

highest in the chart in 2001 (at $1.7) and the lowest in 2003 (at $1) prior to reaching just over 1.5 in 2004. 

The banana costs(10) in Germany almost exactly mirrored this fluctuating trend, hovering(11) around the 1.4 

US dollar mark in the first seven years and then falling gradually to about 1.2 in 2004.

Phân tích từ vựng
1.  wild fluctuations: biến động mạnh mẽ

•  Ví dụ: The stock prices of the company experienced wild fluctuations throughout the year, making it difficult 

for investors to predict the market. - Giá cổ phiếu của công ty đã trải qua những biến động mạnh mẽ suốt cả 

năm, làm cho việc dự đoán thị trường trở nên khó khăn đối với nhà đầu tư.

2. 

remained relatively stable: duy trì ổn định một cách tương đối

•  Ví dụ: The temperature in the region remained relatively stable, with only minor variations throughout the 

day. - Nhiệt độ trong khu vực đã duy trì ổn định một cách tương đối, chỉ có những biến đổi nhỏ trong suốt 

ngày.

3. 

the majority of: phần lớn của

•  Ví dụ: The majority of students in the class preferred the first option for the project. - Phần lớn học sinh trong 

lớp ưa thích tùy chọn đầu tiên cho dự án.

4.  peak at: đạt đỉnh điểm tại

•  Ví dụ: The number of visitors to the museum peaked at 1,000 during the summer season. - Số lượng khách 

tham quan bảo tàng đạt đỉnh điểm 1.000 người trong mùa hè.

5. 

rebound: phục hồi (nói về giá cả)

•  Ví dụ: After a period of decline, the stock market rebounded and reached new highs.- Sau một giai đoạn 

giảm, thị trường chứng khoán đã phục hồi và đạt mức cao mới.

6.  be priced at: được định giá là

•  Ví dụ: The new smartphone is priced at $999, making it one of the most expensive on the market. - Chiếc 

điện thoại thông minh mới được định giá là 999 đô la, là một trong những sản phẩm đắt nhất trên thị trường.

7.  a leveling off: ổn định, không có biến động lớn (sau một giai đoạn tăng/giảm)

•  Ví dụ: After a period of rapid growth, the demand for the product leveled off and remained steady. - Sau một 

giai đoạn tăng trưởng nhanh chóng, nhu cầu về sản phẩm ổn định và duy trì ổn định.

8.  a period of stability: một giai đoạn ổn định

•  Ví dụ: The economy enjoyed a period of stability with low inflation and steady growth. - Kinh tế đã có một 

giai đoạn ổn định với mức lạm phát thấp và tăng trưởng ổn định.

9. 

fluctuated wildly: biến động mạnh mẽ

•  Ví dụ: The prices of cryptocurrencies fluctuated wildly, making it a volatile investment. - Giá cả của tiền điện 

tử đã biến động mạnh mẽ, khiến cho nó trở thành một khoản đầu tư biến động.

10.  banana costs: giá cả của chuối

•  Ví dụ: The banana costs in the supermarket have increased significantly due to a shortage in supply. - Giá 

chuối trong siêu thị đã tăng đáng kể do thiếu hụt nguồn cung.

11.  hover: lơ lửng, dao động xung quanh một con số

•  Ví dụ: The temperature in the room hovered around 25 degrees Celsius throughout the day. - Nhiệt độ trong 

phòng lơ lửng xung quanh 25 độ Celsius trong suốt ngày.

Đoạn 2:  Lý do thứ hai: lãnh đạo và quản lý hiệu quả.

•  Trong khi trình độ chuyên môn tốt có thể phản ánh sự thành thạo về mặt 

kỹ thuật, khả năng lãnh đạo và truyền cảm hứng cho người khác cũng quan 

trọng không kém để đạt thành công trong công việc. 

•  Kỹ năng xã hội mạnh mẽ giúp cá nhân khích lệ và hướng dẫn các thành viên 

trong  nhóm,  phân  công  công  việc  một  cách  hiệu  quả  và  đưa  ra  phản  hồi 

mang tính xây dựng.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

In today’s competitive job market(1), employers are placing greater emphasis on(2) hiring individuals with 

strong social skills, in addition to impressive qualifications. This trend has given rise to the idea that the 

former  is  equally  important  as  the  latter  when  it  comes  to  achieving  success  in  a  job.  I  wholeheartedly 

agree with this contention, and this essay will elaborate on myreasons.

First,  social  skills  are  crucial  for  effective  communication(3)  in  the  workplace.  Regardless  of  one’s 

qualifications,  the  ability  to  convey(4)  ideas,  thoughts,  and  information  clearly  is  essential  for  successful 

interactions with colleagues, clients, and superiors. Strong social skills enable individuals to articulate(5) 

their  thoughts  effectively,  actively  listen(6)  to  others,  and  adapt  their  communication  style(7)  to  different 

situations. This fosters a positive and collaborative work environment(8), minimizing misunderstandings, 

and promoting efficient teamwork. For instance, a project manager with excellent technical qualifications 

This publication's user rights are given to

198 | ZIM

may  struggle  to  lead  a  team  effectively  if  they  lack  the  ability  to  communicate  goals  and  expectations 

clearly. Thus, social skills complement qualifications by facilitating effective communication.

Additionally, social skills contribute to effective leadership and management within a professional setting. 

While  good  qualifications  may  showcase  technical  expertise,  the  ability  to  lead  and  inspire  others  is 

equally  important  for  success  in  a  job.  Strong  social  skills  allow  individuals  to  motivate  and  guide  their 

team members, delegate tasks effectively, and provide constructive feedback. Leaders with good social 

skills  can  create  a  positive  work  culture  that  fosters  collaboration,  trust,  and  employee  satisfaction. 

For  example,  a  manager  with  excellent  qualifications  but  poor  interpersonal  skills  may  struggle  to 

communicate  expectations,  build  a  cohesive  team,  and  inspire  their  subordinates.  On  the  other  hand,  a 

leader who possesses strong soft skills can create a supportive environment that encourages creativity, 

engagement, and high-performance levels. Therefore, social skills are paramount for effective leadership 

and management, which in turn contribute to overall job success.

In conclusion, I totally agree that social skills are of equal importance to good qualifications for achieving 

career success.

17.  positive work culture (văn hóa làm việc tích cực): Một môi trường làm việc khuyến khích sự hợp tác, sáng tạo

•  Ví dụ: A positive work culture promotes employee engagement, job satisfaction, and overall productivity. -

Bài mẫu

In  today’s  evolving  job  market,  employers  are  increasingly  recognizing  the  value  of  good  social  skills 

alongside strong qualifications when selecting candidates for employment. While I agree that social skills 

are vital(1) for success in certain jobs, it is important to acknowledge(2) that the significance(3) of qualifications 

may outweigh social skills in other professions.

In  certain  jobs,  social  skills  play  a  pivotal  role  in(4)  achieving  success.  Professions  that  involve  direct 

interaction(5)  with  clients,  such  as  sales  representatives(6)  or  customer  service  agents,  heavily  rely  on(7) 

effective communication and interpersonal skills. The ability to build rapport(8), understand customer needs, 

and provide exceptional service can make a significant difference in these roles. For instance, a salesperson 

with excellent qualifications but poor social skills may struggle to establish trust with(9) potential clients 

and close deals effectively(10). In such cases, social skills become more important than qualifications, as 

they directly impact the job performance(11) and the ability to meet customer expectations(12).

Nevertheless,  there  are  jobs  where  good  qualifications  hold  greater  importance  for  success.  Technical 

fields  such  as  engineering,  medicine,  or  scientific  research  demand  a  high  level  of  expertise(13)  and 

knowledge in specific areas. In these professions, qualifications serve as a benchmark for(14) competence(15) 

and  proficiency(16).  Employers  prioritize  individuals  with  a  solid  educational  background(17),  relevant 

certifications(18),  and  hands-on  experience(19)  to  ensure  the  quality  and  accuracy  of  work.  For  example, 

a  surgeon’s  success  in  the  operating  room  is  determined  by  their  extensive  medical  training(20),  surgical 

skills, and knowledge of the human body. While soft skills are still relevant in these professions, they often 

take a back seat to(21) the technical expertise required to carry out complex tasks.

In  conclusion,  the  ever-changing  job  market(22)  recognizes  the  importance  of  both  social  skills  and 

qualifications, but their significance varies across different professions. While social skills are crucial in 

roles that involve direct interaction with clients and require effective communication, good qualifications 

are of greater importance in technical fields that demand specialized knowledge and expertise.

(323 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

Bài mẫu

The table gives a breakdown of water usage for three sectors in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, New Zealand and 

Canada.  Overall,  domestic  activities(1)  consume  the  least  water  in  all  these  nations.  Additionally,  while 

the industrial sector is the largest user of water(2) in New Zealand and Canada, the majority of(3) water 

consumption is attributed to(4) farming activities in Egypt and Saudi Arabia.

Regarding domestic purposes, the percentage of water used in Canada is the highest, at 20%, which is 

exactly double(5) that of New Zealand. Meanwhile, the figures for Egypt and Saudi Arabia are similar but 

negligible(6), at 8% and 6% respectively.

In terms of industrial activities, 70% of the total water consumption is for these purposes in Canada, the 

highest among all countries listed. This is distantly followed by(7) New Zealand, Saudi Arabia and Egypt, 

with respective proportions of 46%, 30% and 10%.

Turning  to  the  agricultural  sector,  Egypt  uses  a  significant  82%  of  its  water  for  it,  compared  to  64%  in 

Saudi Arabia. At the same time, this sector accounts for 44% of New Zealand’s water use, and in the last 

position is(8) Canada, as agriculture in this country constitutes(9) merely one-tenth of the total.

(196 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

Phân tích từ vựng

1.  domestic (adj) activities (n)

 p domestic: liên quan đến/thuộc về các vấn đề trong gia đình

Bài mẫu 1: Đồng ý hoàn toàn

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm  cá  nhân: Đồng  ý  với việc  là việc  chăm  sóc  người già là trách 

nhiệm pháp lý của các thành viên trẻ trong gia đình. 

Thân bài

Đoạn 1 - Lý do đầu tiên: Nghĩa vụ đạo đức cố hữu của mỗi gia đình: 

•  Mối quan hệ gia đình được xây dựng trên tình yêu thương, sự quan tâm và 

hỗ trợ lẫn nhau. 

•  Do đó, khi những người cao tuổi không còn khả năng chăm sóc bản thân, 

việc  chăm  dưỡng  và  hỗ  trợ  cần  do  các  thành  viên  gia  đình  trẻ  tuổi  đảm 

nhận. 

•  Ví dụ, một bậc cha mẹ già đã dành thời gian và nguồn lực để nuôi dưỡng 

con cái của mình nên có thể dựa vào sự hỗ trợ của con cái khi họ cần đến 

nhất. 

•  Các nghĩa vụ pháp lý, do đó, củng cố nghĩa vụ đạo đức này và tạo ra một 

khung hỗ trợ pháp lý để đảm bảo phúc lợi của các thành viên cao tuổi trong 

một gia đình.

Đoạn 2 - Lý do thứ hai: Những lợi ích thực tiễn mà các thành viên gia đình trẻ tuổi sở 

hữu có khả năng mang lại cho người cao tuổi. 

•  Các thành viên trẻ tuổi thường có sức khỏe tốt hơn về mặt thể chất và tinh 

thần, cho phép họ có thể cung cấp sự hỗ trợ về các khía cạnh này cho người 

thân cao tuổi của họ. 

•  Hơn nữa, các thành viên gia đình trẻ tuổi thường ở giai đoạn cuộc sống có 

tài chính ổn định hơn. Sự ổn định tài chính này cho phép họ đảm nhận gánh 

nặng tài chính của việc chăm sóc sức khỏe, nhà ở và các nhu cầu cần thiết 

khác của người thân cao tuổi. 

•  Bằng cách thiết lập nghĩa vụ pháp lý, gánh nặng chăm sóc được phân phối 

công bằng hơn giữa các thành viên gia đình, đảm bảo rằng người cao tuổi 

nhận được sự hỗ trợ cần thiết. 

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

Some  people  believe  that  younger  family  members  be  held  legally  responsible  for  supporting  elderly 

individuals  who  are  no  longer  physically,  mentally,  or  financially  capable  of  caring  for  themselves.  I 

wholeheartedly agree with this proposition(1) and firmly believe that legal obligations(2) should be imposed 

to ensure the well-being(3) and support of elderly family members.

To begin with, younger family members have an inherent moral obligation(4) to assume legal responsibility 

This publication's user rights are given to
Mã đơn hàng: Z021241122 | Phone: 0963758090 | Email: thaykienchuyenanh@gmail.com

210 | ZIM

for  the  care  and  support  of  their  elderly  relatives(5).  Family  bonds  are  built  on  love,  care,  and  mutual 

support(6). Therefore, when elderly individuals reach a point where they are unable to care for themselves, 

it is the responsibility of younger family members to step in and provide the necessary assistance(7). For 

instance,  an  aging  parent  who  once  devoted  their  time  and  resources  to  raising  their  children  should  be 

able to rely on(8) their children’s support when they require it the most. Legal obligations, thus, reinforce this 

moral duty(9) and create a framework for ensuring the welfare(10) of elderly family members.

Another  compelling  reason  for  legal  responsibility  is  the  practical  advantages(11)  that  younger  family 

members  possess.  Younger  individuals  are  often  in  better  physical  and  mental  health,  enabling  them  to 

provide the physical assistance and emotional support(12) that elderly relatives need. Additionally, younger 

family members are typically at a stage in their lives where they have a more stable financial situation(13). 

This  financial  stability  allows  them  to  bear  the  financial  burdens(14)  of  healthcare,  housing,  and  other 

essential needs(15) that may arise. By establishing legal responsibilities, the burden of care is distributed 

more fairly among family members, ensuring that elderly individuals receive the support they require.

In conclusion, I firmly support the notion that younger family members should be held legally accountable 

for(16) providing assistance to their old relatives who are unable to independently care for themselves.

(303 words)

Bài mẫu 2: Hoàn toàn không đồng ý 

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa  ra  quan  điểm  cá  nhân:  Không  đồng  ý  với  việc  chăm  sóc  người  già  là  trách 

nhiệm pháp lý của các thành viên trẻ trong gia đình.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Lý do đầu tiên: Áp lực tiềm ẩn có thể gây ra cho cuộc sống của người trẻ. 

•  Các thành viên trẻ tuổi thường có những trách nhiệm riêng của mình, như 

sự nghiệp, việc nuôi dạy con cái và các nghĩa vụ tài chính.

•  Ép buộc họ chịu trách nhiệm pháp lý trong việc chăm sóc người thân lớn 

tuổi có thể làm xáo trộn cuộc sống của họ và hạn chế khả năng theo đuổi 

mục tiêu cá nhân. 

•  Ví dụ, một chuyên gia trẻ tuổi có lịch làm việc căng thẳng có thể cảm thấy 

vô cùng khó khăn trong việc thực hiện các nghĩa vụ pháp lý này trong khi 

cùng  lúc  phải  cân  bằng  giữa  sự  phát  triển  chuyên  môn  và  hạnh  phúc  cá 

nhân của mình. 

•  Công nhận sự tự chủ và tự do cá nhân của các thành viên trẻ tuổi trong gia 

đình cho phép họ đưa ra quyết định phù hợp với hoàn cảnh của mình mà 

không phải đối mặt với các gánh nặng không cần thiết.

Đoạn 2: Lý do thứ hai: Sự hiện diện của các hệ thống hỗ trợ thay thế tốt hơn dành 

cho người cao tuổi. 

•  Nhiều nước có các chương trình phúc lợi xã hội, dịch vụ cộng đồng và cơ sở 

y tế được thiết kế đặc biệt để đáp ứng các nhu cầu của người cao tuổi. 

•  Bằng cách chỉ dựa vào các thành viên trong gia đình trẻ tuổi, chúng ta có 

thể bỏ qua những lợi ích và nguồn lực tiềm năng mà các hệ thống hỗ trợ bên 

ngoài này có thể cung cấp. 

•  Ví dụ, người cao tuổi có thể nhận được sự chăm sóc và hỗ trợ toàn diện từ 

các chuyên gia được đào tạo chuyên về chăm sóc người già, đảm bảo các 

nhu cầu cụ thể của họ được đáp ứng một cách toàn diện. 

•  Khuyến khích việc phát triển các mạng lưới hỗ trợ đa dạng như này có thể 

phân phối trách nhiệm một cách hiệu quả hơn và ngăn chặn những áp lực đè 

nặng lên các thành viên trẻ tuổi trong gia đình.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

If  elderly  individuals  reach  a  point  where  they  are  unable  to  care  for  themselves  physically,  mentally,  or 

financially,  it  has  been  suggested  that  younger  family  members  should  bear  legal  responsibility  for(1)

supporting them. However, I respectfully disagree with this proposition to a significant extent.

One  compelling  reason  why  younger  family  members  should  not  be  legally  obligated  to  support  elderly 

relatives is the potential strain(2) it may place on their own lives. Younger individuals often have their own

responsibilities,  such  as  careers,  raising  children,  and  financial  obligations(3).  Forcing  them  into  legal 

responsibility  for  the  care  of  elderly  family  members  can  disrupt  their  own  lives  and  limit  their  ability 

to  pursue  personal  goals(4).  For  example,  a  young  professional  with  demanding  work  hours  may  find  it 

exceedingly  difficult  to  fulfill(5)  their  legal  obligations  while  balancing  their  own  professional  growth  and 

personal  well-being.  Recognizing  the  individual  autonomy(6)  and  freedom  of  younger  family  members 

allows them to make decisions that best suit their circumstances without undue burden(7). 

Another crucial consideration is the availability of alternative support systems(8) for elderly individuals. In 

many  societies,  there  are  social  welfare  programs(9),  community  services,  and  healthcare  institutions(10) 

specifically designed to cater to(11) the needs of the elderly. By relying solely on younger family members, we 

may overlook(12) the potential benefits and resources that these external support systems can provide. For 

instance, elderly individuals may receive comprehensive care(13) and assistance from trained professionals 

who specialize in eldercare(14), ensuring their specific needs are met in a holistic(15) manner. Encouraging 

a diverse range of support networks can distribute the responsibility more effectively and prevent younger 

family members from being overwhelmed by the demands of caregiving(16).

In  conclusion,  I  disagree  with  legally  obligating  younger  family  members  to  support  elderly  relatives,  as 

it  hinders  personal  growth  and  imposes  undue  pressure,  and  there  are  also  better  alternative  support 

systems that should be explored.

Bài mẫu

The pie chart and table show where tourists at a specific Australian holiday resort come from, how long 

they stay on average, and which types of accommodation and activities they opt for(1). 

Overall,  European  and  Asian  visitors  constitute  the  majority  of(2)  the  resort’s  customer  base,  with  the 

former spending the longest time here and having the same choice of accommodation(3) as those from 

other regions. Additionally, sightseeing is the preferred holiday activity(4) among tourists from Asia and 

America.

Regarding tourists’ origins, the percentages of travelers of European and Asian nationality(5) at the resort 

are the highest, at 37% and 35% respectively. This is distantly followed by US visitors, accounting for nearly 

one-fifth of the total, compared to only one-tenth of those from other parts of the world.

Turning to the average length of stay, European and American tourists spend the most time at the resort, 

with respective durations(6) of 16 and 14 days, whereas visitors from Asia and other areas have shorter 

vacations(7) here, typically lasting 7 and 10 days, in that order. In terms of accommodation preferences(8), 

whilst  camping  or  caravanning  is  the  top  choice  amongst  Europeans  and  people  from  other  regions, 

their Asian and American counterparts decide to stay in 4-5-star hotels. As for recreational activities(9), 

sightseeing is the primary choice(10) for Asian and American tourists, while Europeans mainly engage(11) in 

swimming or sunbathing, and other travelers favor surfing.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Lý do đầu tiên: ngăn cản việc tiêu thụ quá mức và khuyến khích các cá nhân 

lựa chọn các sản phẩm thay thế tốt cho sức khỏe hơn.

•  Chẳng hạn, nếu giá của một loại đồ uống có đường cao hơn đáng kể so với

lọc hơn, và nhờ thế giảm lượng calo nạp vào.

Đoạn 2: Lý do thứ hai: có thể giúp bù đắp chi phí xã hội liên quan đến bệnh béo phì.

•  Béo  phì  không  chỉ  ảnh  hưởng  đến  sức  khỏe  của  mỗi  cá  nhân  mà  còn  đặt 

gánh nặng lên các hệ thống chăm sóc sức khỏe và nền kinh tế. 

•  Bằng cách tăng giá thực phẩm không lành mạnh, doanh thu tạo ra từ việc này 

có thể được phân bổ cho các sáng kiến và chương trình nhằm tăng cường 

sức khỏe cộng đồng và ngăn ngừa béo phì.

Kết bài

Bài mẫu

In today’s society, the issue of obesity is becoming increasingly prevalent(1), with more and more people 

struggling with serious weight problems(2). Some individuals argue that the solution lies in raising the price 

of fattening foods. I completely agree with this viewpoint, and this essay will elaborate on my reasons.

Firstly,  increasing  the  price  of  unhealthy,  weight-inducing  food  items(3)  can  discourage  excessive 

consumption(3) and encourage individuals to opt for healthier alternatives(5). When unhealthy food items 

become more expensive, people are more likely to reconsider their choices(6) and seek out more nutritious 

options(7).  For  instance,  if  the  cost  of  a  sugary  beverage(8)  is  significantly  higher  than  that  of  a  bottle  of 

water, individuals may be more inclined to(9) choose the latter, thereby reducing their calorie intake(10). By 

creating  a  financial  disincentive(11)  for  unhealthy  food  choices,  people  are  more  likely  to  make  healthier 

decisions for the benefit of their well-being.

Secondly, raising the price of fatty foods can help offset(12) the societal costs(13) associated with obesity. 

Obesity not only takes a toll on(14) individuals’ health but also places a burden on(15) healthcare systems and 

economies. By increasing the price of unhealthy foods, the revenue(16) generated can be allocated towards 

initiatives  and  programs  aimed  at  promoting  public  health(17)  and  preventing  obesity. This  could  include 

funding  educational  campaigns(18),  subsidizing  healthier  food  options(19),  and  supporting  fitness  and 

wellness programs(20). Ultimately, the financial resources generated from higher prices can be reinvested 

into combating obesity(21) and creating a healthier society.

In  conclusion,  I  firmly  support  the  idea  of  increasing  the  prices  of  fattening  foods  as  a  solution  to  the 

growing  issue  of  obesity,  given  how  this  policy  can  discourage  excessive  consumption  and  promote 

healthier choices among consumers, and how the additional revenue generated(22) can be utilized to fund 

obesity prevention programs and alleviate the societal costs linked with this pressing health concern(23).

(304 words)

Bài mẫu 2: Không đồng ý

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: Không đồng ý với việc tăng giá thức ăn gây béo là một 

giải pháp hữu hiệu cho vấn đề thừa cân đang ngày càng phổ biến hiện nay.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Lý do đầu tiên: béo phì bị ảnh hưởng bởi nhiều yếu tố khác ngoài sự sẵn có 

và giá thành của thực phẩm. 

•  Tình trạng kinh tế xã hội, giáo dục, ảnh hưởng văn hóa và các yếu tố tâm lý 

đều đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc hình thành thói quen ăn uống và lựa 

chọn lối sống của mỗi cá nhân. 

•  Việc chỉ tăng giá thực phẩm gây béo sẽ không giải quyết được những yếu 

tố cốt lõi này và nó có thể tác động xấu đến những người có thu nhập thấp 

hơn, những người có thể đã phải vật lộn với khả năng tiếp cận hạn chế với 

các lựa chọn thực phẩm tốt cho sức khỏe. 

•  Nếu không giải quyết các nguyên nhân gốc rễ của bệnh béo phì một cách 

toàn diện, việc chỉ tập trung vào giá cả có thể là sẽ không hiệu quả trong 

việc chống lại vấn đề này.

Đoạn 2: Lý do thứ hai: chỉ tập trung vào giá của các loại thực phẩm gây béo không đủ 

để giải quyết các vấn đề hệ thống rộng hơn góp phần vào thói quen ăn uống không 

lành mạnh. 

•  Môi trường hiện đại của chúng ta đầy ắp các loại thực phẩm được chế biến 

cao calo và gây béo, và việc quảng cáo và tiếp thị các sản phẩm không lành 

mạnh đang tràn lan. 

•  Để giải quyết vấn đề béo phì một cách hiệu quả, cần phải xem xét thị trường 

thực phẩm một cách toàn thể, thúc đẩy giáo dục, xử lý nhãn mác và đưa ra 

các quy định giúp tạo điều kiện cho cá nhân có thể đưa ra các sự lựa chọn 

thông thái về thực phẩm. 

•  Một cách tiếp cận toàn diện nên bao gồm các sáng kiến như cải thiện giáo 

dục  dinh  dưỡng  tại  trường,  thực  hiện  ghi  nhãn  thực  phẩm  rõ  ràng  hơn  và 

khuyến khích các lựa chọn thực phẩm có lợi cho sức khỏe tại các trường học, 

nơi làm việc và các không gian công cộng.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

In today’s society, the issue of obesity has reached alarming levels(1), with a growing number of individuals 

grappling with(2) weight problems. While some argue that raising the price of fatty foods is the answer to 

this problem, I completely disagree with this idea, and this essay will elaborate on my reasons.

First and foremost, it is important to recognize that obesity is influenced by various factors beyond(3) the 

This publication's user rights are given to
Mã đơn hàng: Z021241122 | Phone: 0963758090 | Email: thaykienchuyenanh@gmail.com

228 | ZIM

availability  and  cost  of  food.  Socioeconomic  status(4),  education,  cultural  influences,  and  psychological 

factors(5)  all  play  significant  roles  in  shaping  individuals’  eating  habits(6)  and  lifestyle  choices(7). 

Merely  increasing  the  price  of  fattening  foods  fails  to(8)  address  these  underlying  factors,  and  it  may 

disproportionately impact(9) individuals from lower-income backgrounds(10), who may already struggle with 

limited access to(11) healthy food options. Without addressing the root causes of(12) obesity comprehensively, 

a singular focus on price may prove ineffective in combating the issue.

Furthermore, solely targeting the price of fattening foods fails to address the broader systemic issues(13) that 

contribute to unhealthy eating habits. Our modern environment is saturated with highly processed, calorie-

dense  foods(14),  and  the  promotion  of  unhealthy  products  through  advertising  and  marketing  strategies 

is rampant(15). To effectively address obesity, it is essential to address the food environment as a whole, 

promoting education, labeling(16), and regulations that empower(17) individuals to make informed choices(18). 

A comprehensive approach should involve initiatives such as improving nutritional education(19) in schools, 

implementing clearer food labeling, and promoting healthier food options(20) in schools, workplaces, and 

public spaces.

In conclusion, I disagree with the notion that increasing the price of fattening foods alone is the solution to 

the pervasive problem of obesity. To tackle obesity effectively, a holistic approach(21) is required, addressing 

the  complex  factors  that  contribute  to  unhealthy  eating  habits.  By  promoting  education,  regulating  food 

environments, and empowering individuals to make informed choices, we can foster a healthier society(22) 

and deal with the issue of obesity from multiple angles.

•  Dịch nghĩa: những lựa chọn về lối sống
