Bài mẫu

There is an opinion that promoting urban residence(1) over suburban and rural living is the most effective 

approach to addressing traffic and transportation issues. However, I totally disagree with this point of view, 

and this essay will elaborate on my reasons.

Admittedly, proponents of concentrating populations in urban areas(2) might argue that this initiative could 

afford residents better accessibility to public transportation, which in turn leads to a reduced reliance on 

personal  vehicles,  one  of  the  major  contributors  to  traffic  congestion(3).  Nevertheless,  this  perspective 

seems  to  overlook  the  impracticality  of  such  a  strategy  as  the  majority  of  cities  around  the  world  are 

facing the crisis of overpopulation. An illustration of this can be seen in Beijing, where overcrowding has 

been  identified  as  a  primary  driver(4)  of  various  traffic-related  issues,  such  as  traffic  jams  and  a  lack  of 

parking lots. In light of this, the push for greater urban residency could inadvertently worsen these existing 

problems within this metropolis. 

In my opinion, incentivizing urban inhabitants(5) to migrate to the suburbs or the countryside would be a 

superior  approach  to  traffic  and  transport  problems.  This  is  because  by  doing  so,  we  can  significantly 

alleviate  the  burden  on(6)  urban  infrastructure  and  resources.  This  would  naturally  result  in  decreased 

congestion and reduced pressure on transportation networks within city centers. Moreover, suburban and 

rural areas often have ample space to accommodate well-planned transportation networks(7). For instance, 

the town of Davis, California, is renowned for its extensive network of bike lanes and paths that traverse the 

suburban landscape, encouraging residents to use bicycles as a primary mode of transportation(8), thereby 

mitigating traffic congestion and promoting eco-friendly mobility.

In conclusion, while promoting urban living as a remedy for transportation woes holds some appeal, it fails 

to consider the challenges posed by overpopulation. Therefore, I am convinced that encouraging migration 

to suburban and rural areas is a better solution.

(311 words)

tức là trong thành phố hoặc các khu vực đô thị.

The introduction of new technology can help alleviate the burden on manual labor and improve efficiency in 

production processes.

(Sự ra đời của công nghệ mới có thể giúp giảm bớt gánh nặng đối với lao động thủ công và cải thiện hiệu suất trong

Bài mẫu 2: Đồng ý một phần

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: Đồng ý một phần là việc khuyến khích mọi người sống 

ở thành phố hơn là vùng ngoại ô và nông thôn là một cách tốt để giải quyết các vấn 

đề về giao thông và vận tải. Tuy nhiên, đây vẫn chưa phải là cách tốt nhất khi mà 

vẫn còn những cách khác tốt hơn.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Tất nhiên, có một logic nhất định cho lập luận rằng cuộc sống đô thị có 

thể giải quyết các vấn đề về giao thông và vận tải. 

•  Các thành phố cung cấp mạng lưới giao thông công cộng toàn diện có thể 

làm giảm sự phụ thuộc vào các phương tiện cá nhân, do đó giảm bớt sự 

căng thẳng cho các con đường. 

•  Ngoài ra, khoảng cách gần với các tiện nghi và nơi làm việc trong các thành 

phố có thể khuyến khích người dân đi bộ và đi xe đạp. 

•  Đưa ra ví dụ về Bắc Kinh để làm rõ luận điểm.

Đoạn  2:  Tuy  nhiên,  tôi  tin  rằng  một  biện  pháp  toàn  diện  hơn  nằm  ở  việc  quy 

hoạch giao thông vận tải một cách toàn diện. 

•  Đầu tư vào các hệ thống giao thông công cộng hiệu quả bao trùm cả khu vực 

đô thị và ngoài đô thị. 

•  Đồng thời, hỗ trợ sắp xếp công việc linh hoạt có thể phân bổ hiệu quả việc di 

chuyển vào giờ cao điểm, giảm thiểu ùn tắc giao thông. 

•  Đưa ra ví dụ về Singapore và Xtốc-khôm để làm rõ luận điểm.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

The most optimal asnwer to traffic and transportation issues is believed by some to be promoting urban 

residency over suburban and rural living. To a certain extent, I concur with this perspective, although I firmly 

believe that superior solutions exist beyond this narrow focus.

Granted, there is a certain logic to the argument that urban living can tackle traffic and transport problems. 

Proponents assert that cities offer comprehensive public transportation networks(1) that can diminish the 

reliance on personal vehicles, thereby reducing the strain on roads. Additionally, the proximity of amenities 

and workplaces in cities may encourage walking and biking, leading to more sustainable and eco-friendly 

modes of commuting(2). This can be seen in metropolises like Amsterdam and Copenhagen, where a strong 

emphasis on cycling infrastructure(3) has significantly reduced traffic congestion and fostered a culture of 

environmentally conscious mobility.

However,  rather  than  forcibly  shifting  populations,  I  am  convinced  that a  more  holistic  measure(4)  lies  in 

comprehensive transportation planning. This involves investing in efficient public transportation systems 

that  span  both  urban  and  non-urban  areas.  By  integrating  different  modes  of  transit  and  promoting 

shared  mobility  solutions(5),  the  burden  on  roads  can  be  relieved.  Concurrently,  supporting  flexible 

work  arrangements(6)  can  effectively  stagger  peak-hour  travel,  mitigating  traffic  jams.  Evidence  of  these 

solutions  can  be  seen  in  cities  like  Singapore  and  Stockholm,  where  a  combination  of  advanced  public 

transportation  networks(7)  and  remote  work  policies  have  resulted  in  significant  improvements  in  traffic 

congestion, without necessitating a mass migration to urban centers(8).

In  conclusion,  although  advocating  urban  living  has  its  advantages  in  addressing  traffic  and  transport 

woes,  a  comprehensive  strategy(9)  is  essential.  Efficient  public  transport,  shared  mobility  solutions,  and 

flexible work arrangements provide viable alternatives. Insights from cities like Amsterdam, Copenhagen, 

Singapore, and Stockholm highlight the success of comprehensive transportation planning in easing traffic 

problems without requiring widespread relocations.

(301 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

công cộng mà bao gồm nhiều loại phương tiện và dịch vụ, phủ sóng rộng rãi và đầy đủ để đáp ứng nhu cầu di

đô la Úc.

•  Nhập khẩu của Úc vào Nhật Bản, mặc dù ổn định từ năm 2005 

đến 2006, đã trải qua một sự gia tăng đáng kể từ gần 20 tỷ đô 

la Úc ban đầu để đạt mức cao nhất là 40 tỷ đô la Úc vào năm 

2008, sau đó là sự sụt giảm liên tục vào khoảng gần 10 tỷ đô la

The line graphs illustrate the variations in the import and export values(1) of Australia with three different 

countries between 2004 and 2009. Units are measured in Australian dollars (A$). Overall, while Australia’s 

trade with China and Japan increased, the trade figures(2) for the US remained relatively stable over the 

period shown.

Regarding the trade between Australia and China, the export value started at A$20 billion, after which it had 

risen gradually to A$30 billion by 2007 before leveling off(3) at slightly above this level towards the end of 

the timeframe. The value of imports, meanwhile, followed a similar upward trend(4), beginning at just over 

A$10 billion in the first year, surpassing(5) that of exports in 2008, and ending the period at A$40 billion.

Australia’s  imports  to  Japan,  despite  a  plateau(6)  between  2005  and  2006,  experienced  a  considerable 

climb from close to A$20 billion initially to reach a peak of A$40 billion in 2008, followed by a steady fall(7) 

of nearly A$10 billion in the final year. Although there were some fluctuations, imports from Japan grew 

minimally from A$10 to A$11 billion in 2009.

Finally, trade statistics between Australia and the US stayed virtually unchanged(8) throughout, with both 

import and export values hovering around the A$11 and A$30 billion marks respectively.

(221 words)

Bài mẫu

In the contemporary age, opinions diverge concerning the experience of aging. While some contend that 

growing old in the modern era is overwhelmingly negative, others argue that the lives of the elderly today 

have  significantly  improved  compared  to  the  past.  This  essay  aims  to  explore  both  perspectives,  giving 

weight to the notion that aging in the present world brings about significant challenges(1).

Those  who  advocate  for  the  view  that  aging  is  intrinsically  unfavorable(2)  often  emphasize  the  myriad 

challenges  associated  with  growing  old  in  the  modern  world.  They  highlight  health  concerns,  financial 

uncertainties,  and  the  risk  of  social  isolation(3)  that  can  cast  a  shadow  over  the  latter  years  of  life. 

Furthermore, the rapid pace of technological advancements, although advantageous in many ways, might 

inadvertently exacerbate the generation gap(4), making it an uphill battle(5) for the elderly to keep pace with 

the swiftly evolving landscape.

Conversely,  proponents  of  the  notion  that  life  for  the  elderly  has  experienced  substantial  improvement  in 

contemporary  times  put  forth  several  compelling  arguments.  Enhanced  healthcare  and  advanced  medical 

interventions have extended life expectancy(6) and elevated the overall quality of life for seniors. The advent 

of  the  internet  has  revolutionized  connectivity,  enabling  them  to  stay  informed,  maintain  social  ties(7),  and 

engage in a wider range of activities. Additionally, the shifting societal attitudes(8) reflect a more inclusive 

and respectful outlook toward seniors, acknowledging the invaluable wealth of their wisdom and experience.

From  my  standpoint,  the  former  perspective  holds  greater  validity.  While  modern  advancements  indeed 

bring benefits, they concurrently usher in their own set of challenges. The intricacies of modern life can 

undoubtedly pose formidable obstacles(9) for the elderly.

(268 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

Bài mẫu 2: Đồng ý với quan điểm thứ hai

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: Thảo luận là tại sao có 2 luồn quan điểm như trên và 

đưa ra ý kiến là bản thân nghiêng về quan điểm số 2 hơn - rằng cuộc sống của 

người già ngày nay tốt hơn nhiều so với trước đây.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Áp dụng phương pháp Counterargument - Refutation - Tìm hiểu thêm 

cách viết này tại đây: Link.

•  Counterarrgument:  Do  tính  chất  bận  rộn  của  cuộc  sống  hiện  đại,  nhiều 

người trẻ phải dành nhiều thời gian ở nơi làm việc hơn là ở bên cha mẹ già, 

do đó người già có cảm giác cô đơn. 

•  Refutation:  Tuy  nhiên,  vấn  đề  trên  có  thể  được  giải  quyết  với  những  tiến 

bộ công nghệ hiện nay. Hơn nữa, ngày càng có nhiều hệ thống hỗ trợ cộng

gia vào các hoạt động xã hội. 

Đoạn 2: Hơn nữa, tôi đứng về phía những người cho rằng cuộc sống của người 

già ngày nay tốt hơn đáng kể so với quá khứ.

•  Trước  đây,  việc  chăm  sóc  y  tế  cho  người  cao  tuổi  còn  hạn  chế  và  thường 

thiếu sự chăm sóc đặc biệt mà họ cần. 

•  Ngày nay, các công nghệ y tế tiên tiến và chăm sóc lão khoa chuyên biệt đã 

giúp đáp ứng các yêu cầu sức khỏe riêng biệt của người già.

Bài mẫu

In  the  contemporary  era,  opinions  diverge  regarding  the  experience  of  aging.  While  some  assert  that 

growing old in the modern world is inherently negative, others, myself included, argue that the lives of the 

elderly today are notably improved compared to the past.

Granted, some individuals argue that aging in this day and age is entirely disadvantageous. This is because 

many young adults, due to the hectic nature of modern life(1), have to spend more time at the workplace than 

with their old parents, hence a sense of loneliness(2) amongst the elderly. However, this thinking overlooks 

the  fact  that  with  technological  advancements(3),  distance  is  no  longer  a  barrier  to  staying  connected 

between generations. Video calls and social media platforms, namely Facebook and Zalo, enable regular 

virtual  interactions,  mitigating  the  effects  of  physical  separation.  Moreover,  an  increasing  number  of 

community support systems(4) and senior centers have been established, which offer opportunities for the 

elderly to engage in social activities. This, thus, fosters companionship and a sense of belonging among 

them. 

Furthermore, I side with those who claim that life for the elderly in the present day is considerably superior(5) 

to  the  past.  Take,  for  instance,  the  realm  of  healthcare(6).  In  earlier  times,  medical  care  for  seniors  was 

limited and often lacked the specialized attention they needed. Today, advanced medical technologies and 

specialized geriatric care(7) cater to their unique health requirements. Procedures like joint replacements 

enable seniors to regain mobility, and geriatric specialists provide personalized care plans. This not only 

enhances  their  physical  well-being  but  also  underscores  the substantial  enhancements(8)  in  the  elderly’s 

quality of life, illustrating the positive shift from the past to the present.

In  conclusion,  while  opinions  on  aging  vary,  it’s  clear  that  advancements  in  technology  and  healthcare 

have  significantly  enhanced  the  lives  of  the  elderly. The  ability  to  connect  virtually, improved  healthcare 

access(9), and specialized geriatric care highlight the positive trajectory of aging in the modern era.

(318 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

Đoạn 1 - Mô tả xu hướng của mức độ thất nghiệp ở Ireland.

Đoạn 2 - Mô tả xu hướng của số người rời khỏi Ireland.

•  Trong  2  năm  đầu  tiên,  ban  đầu  có  40.000  người  rời  khỏi  đất 

nước Ireland, với sự gia tăng đáng kể sau đó để đạt mức cao 

nhất là khoảng 70.000. 

•  Sau  đó,  khi  đã  giảm  đáng  kể  vào  đầu  những  năm  1990,  con 

số này trải qua một dao động nhỏ vào khoảng 30.000 từ năm 

1988 đến năm 2004, trước khi tăng nhanh lên trên 40.000 vào 

năm cuối cùng.

Bài mẫu

The chart gives information about Ireland’s joblessness levels(1) and the emigration of its population from 

1988 to 2008.

Overall,  there  was  no  clear  correlation(2)  between  unemployment  and  emigration.  Between  1988  and 

1990, while the number of people leaving Ireland increased sharply, the unemployment rate(3) decreased 

gradually.  However,  from  1990  onwards,  both  figures  followed  similar  downward  trends,  except  for  a 

period of relative stability(4) during the early 2000s, after which they both experienced significant rises 

towards the end of the timeframe. 

Regarding the rate of unemployment, it started at nearly 18% of the Irish population in the first year before 

falling to around 15% after 2 years. Despite rising back to about 16% in the early 1990s, the percentage of 

jobless people(5) had plummeted to a low of roughly 5% by 2000. This was followed by a leveling off until 

around 2007, then a rapid climb was witnessed, reaching approximately 10% in 2008.

Turning  to  the  number  of  emigrants  from  Ireland,  in  the  first  2  years,  40.000  left  the  country  initially, 

with a subsequent considerable increase(6) to reach a peak of about 70.000. Thereafter, having dropped 

significantly  in  the  early  1990s,  the  figure  underwent  a  minor  fluctuation(7)  at  around  30.000  between 

1988 and 2004, prior to climbing rapidly to above 40.000 in the final year.

2.  clear (adj) correlation (n)

 p clear: rõ ràng
 p correlation: sự tương quan, mối liên quan

After years of economic turmoil, the country enjoyed a period of relative stability and growth.

trạng thất nghiệp.

Bài mẫu 1

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Nêu rõ bài luận sẽ đưa ra lý do và giải pháp cho cho vấn đề về sự gia tăng sản 

xuất hàng tiêu dùng, điều đã dẫn đến thiệt hại cho môi trường tự nhiên.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Lý do

•  Sự phát triển nhanh chóng của chủ nghĩa tiêu dùng dẫn đến cạn kiệt nguồn 

tài nguyên thiên nhiên quý giá của chúng ta. 

•  Các quy định liên quan tới việc bảo vệ môi trường còn lỏng lẻo, không ngăn 

cản được các nhà máy sản xuất hàng tiêu dùng xả các hóa chất và khí thải 

độc hại ra môi trường xung quanh.

Đoạn 2: Giải pháp

•  Chính  phủ  nên  phải  khởi  động  các  chiến  dịch  nhằm  nâng  cao  nhận  thức 

cộng đồng về hậu quả môi trường nghiêm trọng của sự gia tăng của chủ 

nghĩa tiêu dùng. 

•  Đồng  thời  tăng  cường  các  biện  pháp  trừng  phạt  đối  với  các  nhà  máy  coi 

thường việc xử lý chất thải độc hại.

Kết bài

Tóm tắt các lý do và giải pháp được nêu ra ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

In recent times, we have witnessed a significant surge in the production of consumer goods, a trend that 

has unfortunately contributed to the degradation of our natural world. This complex issue stems from a 

multitude of factors(1), and finding a solution requires a collective endeavor(2) involving all stakeholders.

There exist several catalysts behind the expansion of the consumer industry and its subsequent negative 

impact on the environment. Chief among these is the rapid proliferation of consumerism(3). As the demand 

for goods escalates, the corresponding need for increased production becomes apparent. Consequently, 

industries  engaged  in  manufacturing  these  goods  have  intensified  their  utilization  of  water,  energy,  and 

raw  materials,  resulting  in  the  depletion  of  our  precious  natural  resources(4).  This  challenge  is  further 

aggravated  by  inadequate  environmental  regulations  that  often  fail  to  dissuade  factories  from  releasing 

hazardous chemicals(5) and toxic emissions into the surroundings.

Addressing  these  pressing  environmental  concerns  necessitates  collaborative  actions  from  individuals, 

businesses, and governmental bodies. Firstly, it becomes imperative for governments to launch campaigns 

aimed  at  enhancing  public  awareness  regarding  the  dire  environmental  consequences(6)  of  rampant 

consumerism.  Armed  with  a  comprehensive  understanding  of  these  repercussions,  individuals  are  more 

likely to embrace environmentally conscious behaviors(7), including refraining from excessive purchasing 

and transitioning to eco-friendly alternatives. This shift in consumer behavior, in turn, exerts pressure on 

companies and manufacturers to adopt more sustainable practices. Simultaneously, it is essential to bolster 

punitive measure(8) against factories that disregard proper waste management, including longer business 

This publication's user rights are given to
Mã đơn hàng: Z021241122 | Phone: 0963758090 | Email: thaykienchuyenanh@gmail.com

362 | ZIM

suspensions and legal repercussions for those responsible for such environmental transgressions(9). This 

two-pronged  strategy  holds  promise  for  significantly  mitigating  the  detrimental  effects  stemming  from 

heightened consumer goods production on the environment.

In conclusion, the unchecked growth of consumerism, coupled with lenient environmental regulations(10), 

has  paved  the  way  for  an  expanding  consumer  industry  that  significantly  impacts  our  environment. 

Nevertheless, this challenge can be effectively addressed through coordinated efforts from governments, 

citizens, and corporate entities.

ảnh hưởng đến một tình huống, vấn đề hoặc quyết định.

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Nêu rõ bài luận sẽ đưa ra lý do và giải pháp cho cho vấn đề về sự gia tăng sản 

xuất hàng tiêu dùng, điều đã dẫn đến thiệt hại cho môi trường tự nhiên.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Lý do

•  Khi khối lượng hàng hóa được sản xuất tăng lên thì việc thải chất thải và khí 

thải độc hại từ các nhà máy vào môi trường cũng tăng theo.

•  Ngoài ra, để đáp ứng nhu cầu ngày càng tăng của người tiêu dùng, một loạt 

các sản phẩm sử dụng một lần được giới thiệu.

Đoạn 2: Giải pháp

•  Các công ty nên ủng hộ việc sử dụng các vật liệu thân thiện với môi trường 

hơn. 

•  Hơn  nữa,  chính  phủ  nên  tích  cực  khuyến  khích  áp  dụng  các  quy  trình  sản 

xuất bền vững. 

Kết bài

Tóm tắt các lý do và giải pháp được nêu ra ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

In  the  modern  era,  the  surge  in  manufacturing  consumer  goods  has  led  to  heightened  environmental 

damage(1).  I  will  outline  various  factors  contributing  to  this  problem  and  propose  potential  measures  to 

address it.

To begin, the escalation in consumer goods production exerts a dual negative impact on the environment. 

Firstly, there is the emission of chemical by-products(2) during the manufacturing process, and secondly, 

the proliferation of disposable products(3). As the volume of goods manufactured increases, so does the 

release of toxic waste and emissions from factories into the environment. This results in the pollution of 

water sources and the air, leading to the deaths of numerous aquatic and terrestrial animals(4). Moreover, 

in response to growing consumer demands(5), an influx of single-use products is introduced, many of which 

are non-biodegradable. Despite their short lifespans, these items persist as waste for thousands of years, 

transforming our planet into an extensive landfill and endangering the habitats of various species.

Swift actions are imperative to mitigate the adverse environmental impacts stemming from the escalating 

production of consumer goods. First and foremost, companies should champion the use of eco-friendlier 

materials(6).  A  notable  example  is  the  prominent  coffee  chain  Starbucks,  which  recently  replaced  plastic 

straws with reusable alternatives crafted from materials such as paper or bamboo. Moreover, governments 

need  to  actively  encourage  the  adoption  of  more  sustainable  manufacturing  processes(7).  For  instance, 

many  U.S.  states  provide  tax  incentives  and  benefits  to  businesses  that  employ  renewable  energy 

sources(8), with some companies even being offered the opportunity to procure green energy at lower costs 

than conventional fossil fuels(9).

practices, including the adoption of greener materials.

 p chemical: hóa học

dụng đóng góp vào ô nhiễm môi trường.)

Sắp xếp thông tin

Đoạn 1 - Mô tả Tool A.

• Công cụ A có niên đại từ 1,4 triệu năm trước

• Công cụ này có chiều cao khoảng 7 cm, chiều rộng 3 cm và độ dày 

của nó nằm trong khoảng từ 2 đến 3 cm. 

• Tương tự như công cụ B, công cụ A có phần đế tròn, thuôn nhọn về 

phía trên. Tuy nhiên, công cụ A lại có bề mặt gồ ghề hơn nhiều khi 

nhìn từ phía trước và phía sau, góp phần tạo ra các cạnh lởm chởm 

và phần đầu ít nhọn hơn.

Đoạn 2 - Mô tả Tool B.

• Công  cụ  B  cho  thấy  vẻ  ngoài  hoàn  thiện  hơn,  giống  như  một  giọt 

nước mắt, vì đầu nhọn của nó bén hơn đáng kể trong khi các cạnh 

cũng mịn hơn. 

• Ngược lại với công cụ A, mặt trước và mặt sau của công cụ B trông 

hơi giống nhau, với độ gồ ghề bề mặt ít hơn. 

• Hơn nữa, Công cụ B dài hơn khoảng 5 cm và rộng hơn 2 cm so với 

công cụ A, mặc dù độ dày của chúng gần như giống hệt nhau.

Bài mẫu

The  diagrams  illustrate  a  pair  of  stone  cutting  implements,  namely  tool  A  and  tool  B,  which  find  their 

origins in two differing periods of human history. They were crafted through the technique of chipping 

away(1) small fragments of stone.

Overall, there were noticeable differences between the two tools, with the one from 0.8 million years ago 

having  greater  dimensions(2),  less  rugged  surfaces(3),  and  more  uniform  edges  in  comparison  with  its 

earlier counterpart.

Looking first at tool A, which dates back to(4) 1.4 million years ago, it appears to be highly primitive(5). This 

artifact measures approximately 7 centimeters in height and 3 centimeters in width, and its thickness(6) 

falls within the range of 2 to 3 centimeters. Similar to the later version, tool A features a rounded base, 

tapering(7) toward the top. The latter, however, has much rougher surfaces when viewed from the front 

and the back, thus contributing to its more jagged edges(8) and a less defined pointed end. 

Tool  B,  on  the  other  hand,  shows  a  more  refined  appearance(9),  resembling  a  teardrop(10),  as  its  tip  is 

notably sharper while the sides are also smoother. In contrast to tool A, the front and back of tool B look 

somewhat similar(11), with less surface roughness. Furthermore, Tool B is about 5 centimeters longer and 

2 centimeters wider than its predecessor, although the thickness is almost exactly the same.

(229 words)

mỏng dần, thu nhỏ dần theo thời gian hoặc không gian. Cũng có thể được sử dụng như một danh từ để chỉ 

một đối tượng có hình dáng hẹp hơn ở một đầu so với đầu kia.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The candle tapers at the end as it burns.

(Chiếc nến thu nhỏ ở đầu khi cháy.)

8.  jagged (adj) edges (n)

 p jagged: gồ ghề, răng cưa
 p edges: cạnh, mép

•  Dịch nghĩa: các mép gồ ghề

•  Cách sử dụng: “Jagged edges” được sử dụng để chỉ các mép, cạnh có đặc điểm gồ ghề, không bằng phẳng, 

thường có hình dáng giống như răng cưa.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The broken glass had jagged edges that were sharp to the touch.

(Mảnh vỡ của kính có các mép gồ ghề, sắc bén khi chạm vào.)

9.  refined (adj) appearance (n)

 p refined: tinh tế, tinh vi
 p appearance: diện mạo, vẻ bề ngoài

•  Dịch nghĩa: diện mạo tinh tế, tinh vi

•  Cách sử dụng: “Refined appearance” được sử dụng để chỉ sự xuất hiện hoặc diện mạo của một thứ gì đó được 

tối ưu hóa, được cải thiện để trở nên tinh tế, lịch lãm và tốt hơn về mặt thẩm mỹ.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The designer’s careful selection of colors and materials gave the room a refined appearance.

(Sự lựa chọn cẩn thận về màu sắc và vật liệu của nhà thiết kế đã tạo cho căn phòng một diện mạo tinh tế.)

10.  teardrop (n)

 p teardrop: hình giọt nước mắt

•  Dịch nghĩa: hình giọt nước mắt

•  Cách sử dụng: “Teardrop” được sử dụng để chỉ hình dáng giống như một giọt nước mắt, thường là hình dáng 

hơi dài và có phần hẹp ở một đầu và phần rộng hơn ở đầu kia.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The pendant on her necklace was in the shape of a teardrop.

(Cái dây chuyền của cô ấy có hình dáng là hình giọt nước mắt.)

11.  somewhat (adv) similar (adj)
 p somewhat: một chút, hơi
 p similar: tương tự, giống nhau

•  Dịch nghĩa: hơi tương tự

•  Cách sử dụng: “Somewhat similar” được sử dụng để diễn tả sự tương tự nhưng không hoàn toàn, có một phần 

khác biệt hoặc khác nhau nhỏ.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The two paintings were somewhat similar in style, but one had bolder colors than the other.

(Hai bức tranh có phong cách tương tự một chút, nhưng một bức có màu sắc táo bạo hơn bức còn lại.)

Bài mẫu 1: Hoàn toàn đồng ý

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: Hoàn toàn đồng ý với việc cho rằng chính phủ nên

công nghiệp thực phẩm.

•  Chính phủ có thể áp thuế đối với đồ uống có đường, đưa ra các hạn chế về 

việc tiếp thị đồ ăn vặt cho trẻ em và thực thi các yêu cầu nhãn mác nghiêm

mạnh hơn cho trẻ.

Bài mẫu

In several nations, a growing number of children are grappling with the issue of obesity and deteriorating 

health(1),  with  some  contending  that  governments  bear  the  responsibility  for  addressing  this  concern.  I 

totally agree with this viewpoint because governments can effectively combat childhood obesity through 

comprehensive policies and initiatives.

Firstly,  governments  possess  the  requisite  resources(2)  to  execute  large-scale  interventions  that  can 

effectively confront this challenge. Through the allocation of funds towards public health campaigns and 

educational initiative(3), they can heighten awareness about the significance of adopting healthy lifestyles 

and disseminating essential knowledge regarding nutrition and physical activity. An illustration of this can 

be seen in the case of the “Let’s Move” campaign that unfolded in the United States in 2010, which aimed 

to combat childhood obesity(4) through a synergy of school-based programs, community-driven efforts, and 

alterations in policy frameworks. This governmental endeavor(5) underscored the constructive influence of 

strategic interventions on the well-being of children.

Furthermore,  governments  wield  the  power  to  regulate  industries  contributing  to  the  proliferation  of 

unhealthy dietary options(6). The imposition of taxes on sugary beverages, the introduction of restrictions on 

the marketing of junk food to children, and the enforcement of more stringent labeling mandates exemplify 

measures that can foster an environment promoting healthier dietary choices(7). Evidently, several countries 

have  achieved  noteworthy  success  in  reducing  the  consumption  of  sugary  drinks  by  enacting  levies  on 

such beverages. These policies have translated into enhancements in health indicators(8) among children.

In  conclusion,  I  firmly  support  the  view  that  governments  hold  a  crucial  responsibility  in  addressing 

childhood obesity. Their capacity to allocate resources, implement interventions, and regulate industries(9)

can profoundly impact this challenge, ensuring a healthier future for children.

(276 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

 p health: sức khỏe

•  Cách sử dụng: “Obesity and deteriorating health” được sử dụng để chỉ mối liên quan giữa tình trạng béo phì và 

sự suy thoái của sức khỏe, thường là sự suy giảm của sức khỏe về mặt vật lý hoặc tinh thần do béo phì gây ra.

Bài mẫu 2: Đồng ý một phần

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: Đồng ý một phần và cho rằng không những chính 

phủ, mà ngay cả phụ huynh cũng nên cần phải có trách nhiệm giải quyết vấn đề 

trẻ em đang trở nên thừa cân và không khỏe mạnh hiện nay.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Có thể hiểu được tại sao một số người cho rằng chính phủ nên gánh vác 

trách nhiệm giải quyết tình trạng béo phì ở trẻ em.

•  Lý  do  chính  bắt  nguồn  từ  việc  chính  phủ  sở  hữu  nguồn  lực  tài  chính  và 

quyền hạn quản lý. 

•  Ví dụ, chính phủ có thể phân bổ kinh phí để triển khai các chiến dịch nhằm 

nâng cao nhận thức của phụ huynh về chế độ ăn uống lành mạnh. 

•  Chính phủ cũng có thể áp đặt mức thuế cao để góp phần giảm mức tiêu 

thụ thức ăn nhanh và hạn chế sự phát triển của các cơ sở kinh doanh loại 

đồ ăn này.

Đoạn 2: Tuy nhiên, việc nâng cao sức khỏe của trẻ em cũng nên cần có sự tham 

gia tích cực của phụ huynh.

•  Điều này xuất phát từ việc chế độ ăn uống của cha mẹ có vai trò lớn trong 

việc hình thành thói quen ăn uống của trẻ. 

•  Ngoài  ra,  cha  mẹ  có  thể  góp  phần  cải  thiện  sức  khỏe  của  con  mình  bằng 

cách thúc đẩy trẻ có lối sống năng động hơn.

Bài mẫu

In  recent  years,  there  has  been  an  increasing  number  of  unhealthy  and  obese  children  in  many  nations, 

giving  rise  to  the  belief  that  the  government  should  take  responsibility  for  tackling  this  alarming  issue. 

Although  this  contention  is  valid  to  some  extent,  I  would  argue  that  curbing  childhood  obesity  indeed 

warrants a concerted effort(1) between the state and parents.

Admittedly, it is understandable why some suggest that the government should shoulder the responsibility of 

addressing childhood obesity. The primary reasoning is rooted in their possession of financial resources(2) 

and regulatory authority(3). For instance, the government could allocate funds to launch additional campaigns 

aimed at enhancing parental awareness(4) regarding the dire consequences linked to unhealthy diets. Armed 

with this knowledge, parents would likely monitor their children’s eating habits more closely and avoid foods 

that  contribute  to  excessive  weight  gain(5).  Beyond  awareness  efforts,  the  government  could  employ  its 

authority to impose substantial taxes on(6) fast food, thereby reducing its frequent consumption and limiting 

the growth of fast food establishments, significant factors contributing to declining children’s health.

Nevertheless, I hold the belief that, alongside government efforts, enhancing children’s health necessitates 

active  involvement  from  parents.  This  stems  from  the  influential  role  parents’  dietary  choices(7)  play  in 

shaping children’s eating habits. Put differently, children whose parents consume fast food regularly are 

more prone to adopt this pattern, elevating their risk of obesity. Additionally, parents can contribute to their 

children’s well-being by promoting a more active lifestyle(8). Early instruction in exercise, for instance, can 

substantially contribute to children’s overall health. This is arguably where parental influence(9) surpasses 

that of governments.

In  conclusion,  in  order  to  effectively  resolve  the  problem  of  childhood  obesity,  I  am  of  the  opinion  that 

parents should act in concert with(10) the government.

(289 words)

Bài mẫu

The bar graph illustrates how the young in Europe expect five different life aspects to change over the 

following two decades.

Overall, the majority of(1) young individuals polled anticipated that communication between people would 

become better after 20 years, whereas the opposite was true in the cases of the other surveyed areas. It 

is also noteworthy that the difference between youngsters’ expectations about health and water quality 

was negligible(2). 

Regarding people’s health and communication, slightly above 40% and 60% of young people in the survey 

predicted  that  these  aspects  would  see  improvement(3),  respectively.  This  means  that  more  young 

respondents(4) forecast that the former is going to worsen in comparison with the latter.

Turning  to  the  other  categories,  there  is  a  small  gap  between  young  people’s  responses  regarding  the 

quality of water and food, with 60% and roughly 52% of them claiming that these areas will degenerate(5), 

in  that  order.  Air  quality,  meanwhile,  received  the  worst  outlook(6),  as  nearly  four-fifths  of  the  young 

believed that it would deteriorate(7).

Bài mẫu

There is an opinion that employers should not overly concern themselves with what their employees wear, 

as their quality of work should be the primary focus(1). I wholeheartedly agree with this viewpoint, and this 

essay will elaborate on my reasons.

The  major  consideration(2)  for  employers  should  indeed  be  the  quality  of  their  employees’  work.  When 

employers prioritize  work performance(3) over dress code, they create an environment where employees 

can focus on their tasks without unnecessary distractions. For example, in the tech industry, companies like 

Apple have adopted a more relaxed dress code, allowing employees to wear casual attire(4). This approach 

has contributed to a culture of innovation, where employees feel comfortable and empowered to generate 

groundbreaking ideas(5). By emphasizing work quality over attire, companies like Apple have demonstrated 

that allowing employees to dress comfortably can lead to enhanced creativity and productivity(6). 

Furthermore,  an  excessive  focus  on  dress  codes  can  negatively  impact  inclusivity  and  diversity  within 

the  workplace.  When  employers  impose  strict  dress  codes,  they  may  inadvertently  exclude(7) employees 

from various cultural backgrounds who have unique clothing preferences(8), or requirements. For example, 

in  multinational  corporations  with  employees  from  diverse  cultures,  mandating  a  Western  dress  code 

might alienate those who prefer traditional attire. Embracing a more flexible dress code policy fosters an 

inclusive environment where employees from different cultural backgrounds(9) feel respected and valued, 

contributing to a more harmonious and diverse workplace.

In  conclusion,  employers  should  place  their  main  focus  on  the  quality  of  their  employees’  work  rather 

than micromanaging their attire. As exemplified by companies like Apple and multinational corporations, 

this  approach  not  only  enhances  work  performance  but  also  fosters  an  inclusive  and  diverse  working 

environment(10).

(275 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

 p primary: chính, chủ yếu
 p focus: tập trung, trọng tâm

•  Cách sử dụng: “primary focus” được sử dụng để chỉ sự tập trung chính, mục tiêu chính hoặc ưu tiên hàng 

đầu trong một tình huống hoặc ngữ cảnh cụ thể.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

In this project, the primary focus is on improving customer satisfaction.

(Trong dự án này, trọng tâm chính là cải thiện sự hài lòng của khách hàng.)

2.  major (adj) consideration (n)
 p major: Chính, quan trọng
 p consideration: Xem xét, xem xét kỹ lưỡng

•  Dịch nghĩa: Xem xét chính

•  Cách sử dụng: “ major consideration” thường được sử dụng để chỉ một yếu tố quan trọng, điều quan trọng 

cần xem xét hoặc cân nhắc trong một quyết định, kế hoạch hoặc tình huống cụ thể.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The major consideration when choosing a college is the quality of the education it provides.

Bài mẫu

In today’s workplace, there is an ongoing debate about whether employers should concern themselves with 

what their employees wear, with some arguing that the focus should solely be on their work quality. I find 

myself leaning towards a middle ground on this issue, believing that the importance of an employee’s attire 

should be contingent on the nature of their profession.

In creative industries(1) such as graphic design and advertising, an individual’s attire often serves as a form 

of self-expression and inspiration. Here, employees thrive when they have the freedom to dress in a way 

that aligns with their creative mindset(2). For instance, renowned fashion designers like Karl Lagerfeld and 

Stella  McCartney  were  known  for  their  distinctive  and  unconventional  personal  styles(3),  which  not  only 

reflected their creativity but also enhanced it. In creative professions, it is essential for employers not to 

stifle individuality(4) with rigid dress codes(5), as doing so can hinder the innovative thinking that propels 

these industries forward.

Conversely,  there  are  industries,  like  law  and  finance,  where  maintaining  a  professional  appearanc(6)  is 

paramount.  In  these  fields,  clients  and  partners  often  expect  a  certain  level  of  formality  and  adherence 

to  dress  codes.  For  example,  a  lawyer  representing  a  high-profile  client  in  a  courtroom  must  project 

professionalism(7)  to  instill  confidence(8)  in  their  abilities.  Financial  advisors,  similarly,  need  to  convey 

trustworthiness(9)  through  their  appearance  when  handling  clients’  investments.  Employers  in  such 

professions, therefore, should indeed care about the way their employees dress to meet the expectations 

of their respective industries and maintain the trust of their stakeholders.

In conclusion, I am convinced that the extent to which employers should consider their employees’ attire 

hinges on the specific demands of the profession. Creative sectors, for example, thrive when employees 

enjoy  the  liberty  to  manifest  their  individuality  through  clothing,  while  sectors  such  as  healthcare  and 

finance necessitate stringent dress codes to project an image of professionalism and instill confidence.

(315 words)

Bài mẫu

The  table  illustrates  how  much  water  costs  across  five  major  urban  areas(1)  in  Australia.  Overall,  there 

are increases in usage charges once people in Adelaide, Brisbane, and Perth use more than 125 kiloliters 

(KL) of water, whereas the other two cities in question maintain consistent water pricing(2). Additionally, 

while the highest average water bill per household is recorded in Perth, the opposite is true in the case 

of Melbourne.

Regarding usage charges for the initial 125 KL, Adelaide and Perth have the cheapest rates, both standing 

at  $0.42. This  is  in stark  contrast(3)  to  Sydney,  as  it  imposes  the  highest  cost  at  $0.98  in  this  category. 

Meanwhile, a close similarity can be seen in the charges levied by Brisbane and Melbourne, with respective 

figures of $0.81 and $0.78.

When water usage exceeds 125 KL, water prices(4) in Adelaide and Perth climb approximately twofold and 

threefold, respectively, making them the most expensive out of the five cities listed. A slight rise of $0.03 

is also witnessed in Brisbane, but residents in Sydney and Melbourne still pay the same rates.

Turning to the average water bill, an Australian household living in Perth pays $332, followed by those in 

Sydney, Adelaide, and Brisbane, with their expenses(5) being around $310. In the last place is Melbourne, 

where a family spends only $253.

Bài mẫu

There is an opinion that schools should prioritize academic success and examination performance over 

teaching  practical  skills  like  cookery,  dressmaking,  and  woodwork,  which  are  better  learned  from  family 

and friends. I wholeheartedly support this view, as academic achievements and passing examinations are 

fundamental to a student’s future prospects(1).

In  the  realm  of  academic  and  examination  success,  schools  play  a  pivotal  role  in(2)  imparting  essential 

knowledge  and  skills.  This  is  because  academic  subjects  provide  students  with  a  broad  foundation  of 

understanding,  critical  thinking  abilities(3),  and  analytical  skills  that  are  applicable  across  various  career 

paths.  Doing  well  in  examinations,  meanwhile,  not  only  demonstrates  a  student’s  competency  but  also 

opens  doors  to  higher  education(4),  and  professional  opportunities.  For  instance,  strong  performance 

in  subjects  like  mathematics  and  science  equips  individuals  with  problem-solving  abilities(5)  that  are 

invaluable in fields such as engineering and medicine.

Conversely, when it comes to acquiring practical skills like cooking, sewing, and woodworking, family and 

friends frequently prove to be more effective instructors(6). The major reason for this is that these skills are 

deeply rooted in cultural and familial traditions(7), and they offer valuable bonding experiences. Learning to 

cook from a family member, for instance, not only imparts culinary expertise but also strengthens familial 

connections(8). Additionally, these skills can be highly personalized to  individual  tastes  and  preferences(9) 

when learned within the familial context.

In  conclusion,  although  practical  skills  have  their  merits,  I  am  convinced  that  schools  should  primarily 

focus  on(10)  academic  success  and  passing  examinations.  A  solid  academic  foundation  equips  students 

with essential skills for the future, while practical skills can be enriched within familial and social contexts.

(267 words)

Bài mẫu

It  is  believed  by  some  that  the  primary  focus  of  schools  should  be  on  academic  success  and  achieving 

good results in examinations, while practical skills such as cookery, dressmaking, and woodwork are better 

suited  for  learning  from  one’s  family  and  friends.  Although  I  acknowledge  the  undeniable  importance  of 

schools prioritizing academic achievements and examination results(1), I also believe that there is merit in 

integrating these practical skills into the school curriculum.

Admittedly, it is undeniable that schools should give precedence to(2) achieving academic excellence and 

succeeding in examinations. Regarding the former, it instills critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and 

a deep understanding of various subjects. These skills are not only valuable within the academic realm(3) 

but are also highly transferable to real-life situations. They form the bedrock upon which individuals build 

their careers and contribute to society. Additionally, examinations serve as vital assessments of a student’s 

understanding  and  mastery  of  academic  content. They  provide  a  standardized  and  objective  measure(4) 

of a student’s capabilities, which is essential for universities and employers when evaluating candidates. 

Strong performance in examinations opens doors to higher education and career opportunities(5), allowing 

individuals to pursue their aspirations.

At the same time, it is worth acknowledging that practical skills like cookery, dressmaking, and woodwork 

have their place in education. These skills provide hands-on learning experiences(6) that nurture creativity, 

problem-solving abilities, and craftsmanship. Whilst these skills are often learned from family and friends, 

not all students have access to such guidance. Thus, integrating practical skills into the school curriculum 

can provide equal opportunities for all students to acquire these valuable life skills(7). 

In  conclusion,  schools  should  indeed  prioritize  academic  success  and  examinations,  but  I  feel  that  they 

should also consider integrating practical skills into their curriculum. This is because such an educational 

initiative(8) can ensure students are equipped with the skills they need for a successful future.

Bài mẫu

The charts give a breakdown of class sizes in primary schools across four Australian regions in 2010.

Overall, classes having 21-25 students held the largest share(1) in all four states surveyed, except for South 

Australia, where classes with under 20 students were most common. In contrast, classes containing over 

29 students were a rarity(2) in these areas.

Looking first at New South Wales, 37% of the primary-level classes(3) in this state had 21-25 students, 

followed closely by those with 26-30 and fewer than 20 students (33% and 26% respectively). In South 

Australia,  meanwhile,  the  percentages  of  classes  comprising  under  31  students  ranged  from  28%  to 

36%, with classes having a maximum of 20 students being the most popular. Notably, the figures for the 

biggest class size(4) in both states were the same, each standing at only 4%.

Turning to Australia Capital Territory, classes consisting of 21-25 students constituted the majority(5), at 

just over half of all class sizes listed, compared to 38% of classes having no more than 20 students. This 

was in stark contrast(6) to classes with 26-30 students, making up one-tenth of the total, ten times higher 

than the smallest class size. In Western Australia, the predominant class size was, again, 21-25 students, 

occupying 42%, while a negligible difference(7) was observed in the proportions of classes with under 20 

and 26-30 students, with figures of 26% and 27%, in that order. In the last position was the largest class 

size, as its share was only 5%.

(238 words)

thể đóng vai trò là chất xúc tác để cải thiện các bệnh viện nhà nước.

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

Good health is perceived by some as a primary human necessity, which leads to the argument that medical 

services  should  not  be  operated  by  profit-oriented  companies(1).  However,  I  am  convinced  that  private 

healthcare,  despite  being  associated  with  certain  drawbacks,  brings  about  more  significant  benefits  for 

people.

It  is  true  that  privatizing  the  medical  sector  comes  with  certain  disadvantages,  with  accessibility  being 

a  chief  concern.  Private  healthcare  entities  often  operate  with  a  strong  profit  motive(2),  necessitating 

substantial  investments  in  cutting-edge  medical  equipment(3),  hiring  top-tier  medical  professionals,  and 

conducting  extensive  marketing  campaigns  to  stay  competitive.  While  these  investments  are  aimed  at 

delivering  high-quality  services,  they  can  inadvertently  make  these  services  inaccessible  to  a  significant 

portion of the population. A stark example of this issue can be observed in the United States, where the 

predominantly private healthcare system(4) has led to exorbitant costs, such as an average ambulance ride 

without insurance costing around $1300, rendering it unaffordable for many low-income families.(5)

Nevertheless,  I  firmly  believe  that  the  advantages  of  private  healthcare  are  more  pronounced.  Private 

hospitals play a crucial role in alleviating the strain on state-owned healthcare facilities(6) during periods 

of  high  demand.  For  instance,  during  the  2019  COVID-19  pandemic  in  Vietnam,  private  hospitals  played 

a  pivotal  role  in  helping  state-run  facilities  cope  with  the  surging  number  of  patients.  Furthermore, 

This publication's user rights are given to
Mã đơn hàng: Z021241122 | Phone: 0963758090 | Email: thaykienchuyenanh@gmail.com

413 | ZIM

competition  among  privately-owned  healthcare  institutions  can  act  as  a  catalyst  for  improvement(7)  in 

state-run hospitals. The desire to retain their customer base and market position motivates state hospitals 

to enhance their medical services and technology, ultimately resulting in higher-quality care for patients. 

This can translate into shorter waiting times(8) for examinations and surgeries, as well as improved access 

to modern healthcare amenities.

In  conclusion,  while  private  healthcare  has  its  downsides,  notably  high  costs,  I  contend  that  its  merits, 

including  reducing  pressure  on  state-owned  healthcare  institutions  and  driving  improvements  in  their 

services, carry more weight in the overall assessment of its impact.

(318 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

nhuận và thu lợi ích tài chính cho cổ đông và chủ sở hữu.

Bài mẫu 2 - Nhược điểm lớn hơn ưu điểm

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa  ra  quan  điểm  cá  nhân:  Cho  rằng  nhược  điểm  của  dịch  vụ  chăm  sóc  sức 

khỏe tư nhân lớn hơn những ưu điểm.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Không thể phủ nhận rằng y tế tư nhân có một số lợi ích

•  Dịch vụ chăm sóc sức khỏe tư nhân thường có thể giúp người bệnh tiếp cận 

nhanh hơn tới các dịch vụ và thủ tục y tế.

•  Hơn nữa, các cơ sở chăm sóc sức khỏe tư nhân thường có các thiết bị và 

công nghệ hiện đại nhờ nguồn lực tài chính đáng kể.

Đoạn 2: Tuy nhiên, nhược điểm của dịch vụ chăm sóc sức khỏe tư nhân lại đáng 

kể hơn

•  Thứ nhất, chăm sóc sức khỏe tư nhân thường có chi phí đắt đỏ. Do đó, bệnh 

nhân thường phải chịu gánh nặng về hóa đơn y tế. 

•  Ngoài ra, dịch vụ chăm sóc sức khỏe tư nhân có thể làm trầm trọng thêm sự 

bất bình đẳng về chăm sóc sức khỏe vì nó ưu tiên những người có đủ khả 

năng chi trả. 

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

Many people believe that regards good health as a fundamental human necessity(1), leading to the argument 

that  profit-oriented  companies  should  not  provide  medical  services.  Though  private  healthcare  offers 

certain benefits, I contend that the disadvantages are of greater consequence.

It  is  undeniable  that  private  healthcare  is  beneficial  to  some  extent.  For  instance,  it  can  often  provide 

quicker access to medical services and procedures. In countries with well-established private healthcare 

systems,  patients  can  often  schedule  appointments  and  receive  treatments  faster  than  in  overloaded 

public healthcare systems(2). This efficiency can be crucial, particularly for those in need of urgent care. 

Moreover, private healthcare facilities often boast state-of-the-art equipment and technologies(3) due to 

their significant financial resources. These resources enable them to offer cutting-edge medical procedures 

and treatments(4) that may not be readily available in public healthcare institutions.

However,  the  downsides  of  private  healthcare  are  more  significant.  Firstly,  private  healthcare  is  often 

associated with exorbitant costs(5). Patients, therefore, must bear the burden of high medical bills(6), which 

can lead to financial hardship or even bankruptcy, especially for those without adequate medical insurance. 

For  example,  in  the  United  States,  a  nation  with  a  predominantly  private  healthcare  system,  medical 

expenses  are  a  leading  cause  of  personal  bankruptcy.  Additionally,  private  healthcare  can  exacerbate 

healthcare inequalities(7), as it prioritizes those who can afford it. This creates a two-tiered system(8) where 

This publication's user rights are given to
Mã đơn hàng: Z021241122 | Phone: 0963758090 | Email: thaykienchuyenanh@gmail.com

416 | ZIM

those  with  financial  means  receive  prompt  and  high-quality  care(9),  while  others  face  delays  and  lower-

quality services in the public sector.

In conclusion, although private healthcare offers a number of merits such as quicker access to services and 

advanced technologies, I am of the opinion that the drawbacks, including prohibitive costs and healthcare 

inequalities, are greater.

Bài mẫu

The bar chart illustrates how many visitors of three types visited a particular museum in four different 

years  from  1997  to  2012.  Overall,  adult  visitors  were  the  overwhelming  majority  throughout  the  years, 

whereas the opposite was true(1) in the case of those attending special exhibitions. It is also noteworthy 

that the total number of visitors to this museum increased, with those below 15 years old being the only 

category witnessing a decrease.

In the first year, there were 300,100 visitors of adult age visiting the museum. Over the following decade, 

this  number  experienced  a  significant  rise  to  reach  a  peak  of(2)  400,500,  but  by  2012  had  declined  to 

380,000. Special exhibition visitors followed a similar trend, growing gradually(3) from 28,000 initially to 

42,000 in 2012.

In contrast, 120,000 visitors aged under 15 attended the museum in 1997, after which it dropped steadily(4) 

to 82,300 in the final year. 

Turning to the total attendance(5) at the museum, it started at 448,100 visitors before climbing to a high 

of 525,200 in 2007. By the end of the period, the figure had fallen to 504,300 visitors.

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

Phân tích từ vựng

1.  the (definite article) opposite (adj) was (past tense of “be” verb) true (adj)

 p the: cái
 p opposite: ngược lại
 p was: đã là
 p true: đúng

•  Dịch nghĩa: ngược lại là đúng

•  Cách sử dụng: “The opposite was true” nghĩa là trạng thái hoặc tình huống đã xảy ra hoàn toàn ngược lại với 

những gì đã được nêu trước đó.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

Although they expected rain, the opposite was true, and it turned out to be a sunny day.

(Mặc dù họ mong đợi mưa, ngược lại là đúng, và cuối cùng trời nắng.)

2.  reach (v) a (indefinite article) peak (n) of (prep)

 p reach: kích thước, chiều
 p a: một
 p peak: đỉnh, điểm cao nhất
 p of: của

•  Dịch nghĩa: đạt điểm cao nhất của

•  Cách sử dụng: “Reach a peak of” nghĩa là đạt được đỉnh hay điểm cao nhất của một biến số hoặc sự kiện nào 

đó, thường là trong một khoảng thời gian cụ thể.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The temperature is expected to reach a peak of 35 degrees Celsius tomorrow afternoon. 

(Dự kiến nhiệt độ sẽ đạt đỉnh điểm là 35 độ Celsius vào buổi chiều ngày mai.)

3.  grow (v) gradually (adv)

 p grow: tăng trưởng, phát triển
 p gradually: dần dần, từ từ

•  Dịch nghĩa: tăng trưởng dần dần

•  Cách sử dụng: “Grow gradually” nghĩa là tăng trưởng hoặc phát triển một cách từ từ và không đột ngột.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The plants in the garden grow gradually over the course of the summer, reaching their full height by autumn.

(Các cây trong vườn phát triển dần dần trong suốt mùa hè và đạt đến độ cao tối đa vào mùa thu.)

4.  drop (v) steadily (adv)
 p drop: giảm, sụt
 p steadily: ổn định, đều đặn

•  Dịch nghĩa: giảm đều đặn

•  Cách sử dụng: “Drop steadily” nghĩa là sự giảm xảy ra một cách đều đặn và không có sự biến động lớn.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The temperature has been dropping steadily as we move into the colder months of the year.

(Nhiệt độ đã giảm đều đặn khi chúng ta bước vào những tháng lạnh của năm.)

5.  the (definite article) primitive (adj) attendance (n)

 p the: cái
 p total: tổng cộng, toàn bộ
 p attendance: sự tham dự, sự có mặt

•  Dịch nghĩa: tổng lượng người có mặt hay tham dự

•  Cách sử dụng: “The total attendance” đề cập đến tổng số lượng người hiện diện tại một sự kiện hoặc nơi nào 

đó trong một khoảng thời gian cụ thể.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The total attendance at the concert was over 10,000 people, making it a huge success.

(Tổng lượng người tham dự buổi hòa nhạc là hơn 10,000 người, khiến nó trở thành một sự thành công lớn.)

Task 2

The best way for a country to prepare for the future is to invest resources in its young people. 

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Bài mẫu 1: Hoàn toàn đồng ý

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân:  Đồng ý hoàn toàn với ý kiến cho rằng để có một 

sự chuẩn bị tốt cho tương lai của một đất nước thì cách tốt nhất là nên đầu tư 

nguồn lực vào người trẻ hiện nay.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Thanh niên đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc thúc đẩy sự phát triển 

kinh tế của đất nước.

•  Khi một quốc gia hướng các nguồn lực của mình cho thế hệ trẻ, quốc gia 

đó sẽ có một lực lượng lao động chất lượng cao, có khả năng đóng góp vào 

tiến bộ công nghệ và thích ứng với bối cảnh kinh tế đang thay đổi.

•  Các  quốc  gia  như  Phần  Lan  là  minh  chứng  cho  sự  thành  công  của  sáng 

kiến này. 

Đoạn 2: Đầu tư vào giới trẻ sẽ thúc đẩy sự gắn kết và ổn định xã hội.

•  Bằng cách cung cấp nền giáo dục có chất lượng và dịch vụ chăm sóc sức 

khỏe dễ tiếp cận, một quốc gia đảm bảo rằng thế hệ người trẻ của mình sẽ 

khỏe mạnh hơn, có nhiều hiểu biết hơn và ít có khả năng tham gia vào các 

hoạt động tội phạm hoặc hệ tư tưởng cực đoan.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

Some  people  believe  that  the  most  effective  method(1)  for  a  nation  to  ready  itself  for  the  future  is  by 

allocating resources toward the development of its youth. I wholeheartedly agree with this point of view 

and will elaborate on my reasons in the following essay.

To  begin  with,  it  is  essential  to  recognize  that  young  people  are  the  driving  force  behind  a  country’s 

development. When a nation directs its resources towards its youth, it invests in education, healthcare, and 

social programs that equip the younger generation with the skills and knowledge required to lead in an ever-

evolving world(2). This investment ensures that the workforce remains competitive, capable of contributing 

to  technological  advancements(3)  and  adapting  to  the  changing  economic  landscape(4).  Countries  like 

Finland  exemplify  the  success  of  such  initiatives,  with  their  exceptional  educational  outcomes(5)  and  a 

competitive edge in the global economy.

Furthermore,  investing  in  young  people  promotes  social  cohesion  and  stability(6).  By  providing  quality 

education  and  accessible  healthcare,  a  nation  ensures  that  its  youth  are  healthier,  more  informed,  and 

less  likely  to  engage  in  criminal  activity(7)  or  extremist  ideology(8).  In  turn,  this  contributes  to  reduced 

crime rates, stronger community bonds, and a more harmonious society. Not only are such measures an 

investment in a countries future economy, but also its social harmony(9). 

In conclusion, I completely agree that the most optimal way for a country to prepare for the future is by 

channeling its resources into its young people. This approach guarantees a skilled and adaptable workforce, 

propels innovation, and promotes social stability. As such, it is an investment that pays dividends not only 

in the present but also in the years to come, ultimately securing a brighter future for the nation.

Bài mẫu 2: Đồng ý một phần

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: Đồng ý một phần và cho rằng để có một sự chuẩn bị 

tốt cho tương lai của một đất nước thì đúng là nên đầu tư nguồn lực vào người 

trẻ hiện nay; tuy nhiên, đây không phải là cách tốt nhất khi mà còn nhiều khía 

cạnh khác cũng nên nhận được sự đầu tư tương đương.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Không thể chối cãi rằng việc thúc đẩy sự phát triển của thế hệ trẻ tuổi 

là một khoản đầu tư khôn ngoan đối với một quốc gia.

•  Ví  dụ:  Thông  qua  các  khoản  đầu  tư  đáng  kể  vào  giáo  dục,  y  tế  và  các 

chương  trình  xã  hội  phù  hợp,  Singapore  đã  xây  dựng  được  lực  lượng  lao 

động có tay nghề và trí sáng tạo cao, góp phần thúc đẩy tăng trưởng kinh 

tế của đất nước này.

Đoạn 2: Tuy nhiên, tôi tin rằng việc chuẩn bị cho tương lai đòi hỏi một cách tiếp 

cận đa phương diện hơn.

•  Việc chú trọng quá mức vào đầu tư cho thế hệ trẻ có thể dẫn đến sự mất cân 

bằng trong một quốc gia. 

•  Ví dụ: Mặc dù Nhật Bản có dân số trẻ với trình độ học vấn cao và tay nghề 

tốt nhưng nước này đang phải vật lộn với những thách thức do xã hội già hóa 

và đầu tư cơ sở hạ tầng không đầy đủ đặt ra. Việc này đã cản trở sự tiến bộ 

chung và sự ổn định xã hội ở quốc gia này.

Bài mẫu

Many people believe that securing the future of a nation is best achieved by directing resources into(1) the 

growth and development of its younger generation. However, while I feel that it is undeniably essential, it 

should not be the sole focus of a country’s future planning.

It is indisputable that fostering the development of young people is a wise investment for a country. For 

instance, Singapore has demonstrated the efficacy of such an approach. Through substantial investments 

in  education  and  healthcare,  Singapore  has  cultivated  a  highly  skilled  and  innovative  workforce(2).  This 

well-educated and healthy youth population has not only bolstered economic growth but also positioned the 

country  as  a  global  hub  for  technology  and  innovation(3),  underscoring  the  importance  of  investing  in  the 

young generation for a brighter future.

However,  I  am  convinced  that  future  preparedness  requires  a  multifaceted  approach(4).  Placing  excessive 

emphasis(5) on youth investment to the detriment of other aspects of equal importance, such as infrastructure 

development, environmental sustainability(6), and elderly care, may lead to imbalances within a nation. Such 

an example of this can be seen in Japan. While Japan has a highly educated and skilled youth population, 

it is grappling with the challenges posed by an aging society(7) and insufficient infrastructure investments. 

Neglecting these areas has hindered overall progress and societal stability in Japan, highlighting the need 

for a more balanced approach in order to secure a more stable future..

In  conclusion,  while  investing  in  the  development  of  young  people  is  crucial,  a  balanced  approach  that 

considers all aspects of a nation’s future is imperative. Singapore’s success underscores the importance of 

youth investment, as does the shortfalls found in Japanese society. Therefore, I believe that a comprehensive 

strategy remains the key to a resilient and prosperous future.

(288 words)

Bài mẫu

The bar chart illustrates how absenteeism rates(1), categorized into five different reasons, changed in a 

country in Europe in three separate years, namely 2000, 2005 and 2010. 

Overall, while there were decreases in the percentages of respondents saying that they were absent from 

work due to illness and family duties(2), those citing stress, personal needs and unexpected problems as 

their reasons experienced upward trends. Additionally, illness was consistently the major reason(3), why 

people did not go to work, whereas the opposite was true in the case of stress.

In  the  first  year,  the  proportion  of  individuals  ascribing  their  work  absence  to  sickness  stood  at  nearly 

45%. Despite seeing a steady decline to 35% a decade later, this reason remained the most prevalent(4) 

throughout. Family obligations followed a similar trend, starting at approximately 27% before leveling off 

at just above 25% from 2005 to 2010.

When asked why they were not at work, initially, around 14% of people surveyed attributed it to personal 

needs  such  as  appointments  and  so  on,  after  which  it  had  risen  by  about  one-tenth  by  2010.  Stress, 

meanwhile, saw a lower growth rate(5), beginning at roughly 6% and ending at around 12% in the final year. 

An  increase  was  also  witnessed  in  the  figure  for  unexpected  issues  (transport,  weather  and  suchlike), 

growing from around 8% to peak at close to 15% after 5 years before falling minimally in 2010.

(167 words)

Bài mẫu

In the realm of news consumption, diverse perspectives emerge regarding the most effective medium for 

staying informed. While some argue that newspapers represent the optimal means of accessing news(1), 

an opposing viewpoint suggests that other forms of media offer more efficient alternatives. Nevertheless, I 

am firmly of the opinion that newspapers will continue to be the most superior method for obtaining news.

Admittedly, proponents of other media sources contend that they provide a more efficient and immediate 

way to access news. In the digital era, online news websites and social media platforms offer real-time 

updates(2), ensuring that readers are swiftly informed about unfolding events. The incorporation of multimedia 

elements(3), such as videos and interactive graphics, enhances comprehension and engagement, making 

the  news  more  accessible  and  captivating.  Moreover,  the  portability  of  smartphones  and  the  pervasive 

presence(4) of the internet have made digital news readily accessible on the go, further promoting the idea 

that newspapers are no longer the best way to learn about current events.

However,  I  firmly  believe  that  newspapers  will  remain  the  pinnacle  of  news  dissemination.  Firstly, 

newspapers are synonymous with reliability and credibility(5). They are traditionally authored by seasoned 

journalists who adhere to stringent editorial standards(6), ensuring accurate and well-researched reporting. 

The physicality of a newspaper also offers a tactile and focused reading experience, devoid of the digital 

distractions  that  can  hinder  comprehension.  Furthermore,  newspapers  provide in-depth  analysis(7) and  a 

comprehensive overview of important stories, allowing readers to gain a deeper understanding of complex 

issues, a facet that other media often lacks.

In  conclusion,  although  the  digital  age  has  ushered  in  innovative  and  dynamic  methods  of  news 

consumption,  I  am  convinced  that  newspapers  will  endure  as  the  quintessential  means  of  accessing 

news. Their unwavering commitment to accuracy, comprehensive reporting, and the undistracted reading 

experience they afford make them an enduring and invaluable source of information in our ever-evolving 

media landscape.

(310 words)

Bài mẫu

Opinions vary widely when it comes to the significance of different news sources. While some contend that 

reading newspapers remains the most effective way to stay informed, I assert that, due to the proliferation 

of online news sources(1), it is no longer the optimal method for obtaining news.

Admittedly,  there  are  valid  reasons  supporting  the  perspective  that  newspapers  continue  to  be  the 

preferred medium for news consumption(2). Firstly, newspapers have a long-standing history preceding the 

internet, and this tradition has cultivated a daily reading habit in many older individuals who are hesitant 

to abandon it. Secondly, newspapers are often perceived as a more dependable source of information(3) 

when compared to alternative sources in the present day. This is largely because newspapers are typically 

authored by professional journalists and undergo rigorous scrutiny, editing, and censorship(4) before they 

reach publication.

Nevertheless, I align with those who argue that alternative media, particularly the internet, have emerged as 

a more effective means of accessing news. The primary attraction of online news lies in its accessibility. With 

the widespread ubiquity of the internet, individuals equipped with portable devices(5), such as smartphones, 

can  access  a  vast  repository  of  news  content(6)  with  just  a  few  clicks.  Moreover,  online  news  platforms 

have revolutionized the reading experience through constant technological advancements(7), enabling the 

integration of videos and audio recordings. For instance, contemporary soccer enthusiasts can revisit their 

favorite matches at their convenience, a feat a traditional newspaper cannot replicate.

In  conclusion,  while  I  acknowledge  the  enduring  popularity  of  printed  newspapers  among  specific 

demographics,  I  diverge  from  the  perspective  that  they  remain  the  pinnacle  of  news  consumption. 

Increasingly, people are drawn to the internet as a more dynamic and accessible source of news, making it 

the preferred choice in our evolving information landscape(8). 

(293 words)

Bài mẫu

The  charts  show  how  many  passengers  traveled  by  train  between  2000  and  2009,  along  with  the 

punctuality rate of trains.

Overall,  there  was  an  upward  fluctuation(1)  in  the  number  of  rail  passengers  during  the  given  period. 

Additionally,  except  for  the  period  between  2004  and  2006,  more  trains  ran  punctually.  Although  the 

punctuality target remained unchanged, it was either achieved or exceeded only from 2002 to 2005 and 

again during the last two years of the period in question. 

At the beginning of the period, 40 billion people traveled by train, after which it had risen steadily, reaching 

a peak of roughly 49 billion by 2005, despite a slight drop(2) in 2003. Between 2005 and 2008, a gradual 

decline(3) of about 9 billion passengers was witnessed, with a subsequent recovery to approximately 45 

billion in the final year.

Phân tích từ vựng

1.  upward (adj) fluctuation (n)
 p upward: đi lên, tăng lên
 p fluctuation: sự biến động, sự dao động

•  Dịch nghĩa: sự biến động theo chiều hướng tăng

•  Cách sử dụng:  “Upward fluctuation” nghĩa là sự biến động trong đó giá trị hoặc mức độ của một thứ gì đó tăng 

lên hoặc tăng cao hơn so với mức trước đó.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The stock market experienced an upward fluctuation in prices, leading to increased investor confidence.

(Thị trường chứng khoán đã trải qua sự biến động theo chiều hướng tăng trong giá cả, dẫn đến việc gia tăng 

trong sự tự tin của các nhà đầu tư.)

2.  a (indefinite article) slight (adj) drop (n)

 p a: một
 p slight: nhẹ, ít
 p drop: sự giảm, sự tụt

•  Dịch nghĩa: một sự giảm nhẹ

•  Cách sử dụng: ”A slight drop” nghĩa là mức độ giảm đi nhỏ hoặc không đáng kể so với mức trước đó.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

There was a slight drop in temperature in the evening, but it remained relatively warm throughout the night.

(Có sự giảm nhiệt độ nhẹ vào buổi tối, nhưng nhiệt độ vẫn khá ấm suốt cả đêm.)

3.  a (indefinite article) gradual (adj) decline (n)

 p a: một
 p gradual: dần dần, từ từ
 p decline: sự suy giảm, sự giảm dần

•  Dịch nghĩa: sự suy giảm từ từ

•  Cách sử dụng: “A gradual decline” nghĩa là mức độ giảm dần dần và không đột ngột.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The company experienced a gradual decline in sales over the past year due to changing market conditions.

(Công ty đã trải qua sự suy giảm từ từ trong doanh số bán hàng trong năm qua do điều kiện thị trường thay đổi.)

4.  a (indefinite article) substantial (adj) fall (n)

 p a: một
 p substantial: đáng kể, đầy đặn
 p fall: sự sụt giảm, sự giảm mạnh

•  Dịch nghĩa: sự giảm đáng kể

•  Cách sử dụng: “A substantial fall” nghĩa là mức độ giảm đáng kể, thường liên quan đến một sự thay đổi lớn 

trong giá trị hoặc mức độ của một thứ gì đó.

•  Ví dụ minh họa: 

The stock market experienced a substantial fall in prices, causing panic among investors.

(Thị trường chứng khoán đã trải qua sự giảm đáng kể trong giá cả, gây hoảng loạn cho các nhà đầu tư.)

Bài mẫu

Organizing international sporting extravaganzas like the Olympic Games or the FIFA World Cup undoubtedly 

demands future prospects(1). While some argue that such expenditures are wasteful, others contend that 

they  bring  considerable  benefits  to  the  host  country. This  essay  will  thoroughly  discuss  both  viewpoints 

before concluding that I am in favor of the former.

Admittedly,  proponents  of  hosting  international  sports  events  may  argue  that  the  benefits  outweigh  the 

costs. The key rationale behind this thinking is that these events can significantly boost a nation’s tourism 

industry(2), stimulate local economies(3), and create numerous job opportunities. For example, the 2016 Rio 

Olympics drew millions of tourists, injecting billions into the Brazilian economy and providing thousands 

of  jobs  in  the  process.  This  underscores  the  belief  that  hosting  such  events  can  be  a  sound  economic 

investment. 

However, I side with those who claim that the organization of global sports events is not a prudent financial 

investment. This is because the exorbitant costs(4) associated with constructing state-of-the-art stadiums 

and upgrading infrastructure can place an immense strain on a nation’s budget(5). For example, the 2004 

Athens Olympics left Greece grappling with significant debt due to overspending on infrastructure projects, 

burdening  the  country’s  finances  for  years  to  come.  Additionally,  global-scale  sports  events  often  result 

in  underutilized  facilities  once  they  conclude,  giving  rise  to  maintenance  expenses  that  further  drain 

public funds(6). This can be seen in the case of the 2016 Rio Olympics, where some venues were left unused, 

necessitating  ongoing  maintenance  funded  by  taxpayers.  The  unfulfilled  promise  of  repurposing  these 

facilities for community use exacerbates the financial strain(7) on the host city.

In conclusion, I feel that hosting international sports events is often a wasteful financial endeavor. While there 

are potential benefits, the enormous costs, long-term financial burdens, and underutilized amenities typically 

overshadow these gains.

(298 words)

Band điểm ước lượng: 7.0

án hoặc công việc với hy vọng có lợi nhuận hoặc tạo giá trị tài chính.

The company made substantial financial investments in research and development to create  

innovative products.

(Công ty đã đầu tư tài chính đáng kể vào nghiên cứu và phát triển để tạo ra các sản phẩm mang tính đổi mới.)

khó khăn trong việc trang trải các chi phí cơ bản.)

Bài mẫu 2: Đồng ý với ý kiến thứ hai

Dàn ý

Mở bài

Giới thiệu chủ đề

Đưa ra quan điểm cá nhân: Thảo luận 2 luồng ý kiến và nghiêng về bên cho rằng 

tổ chức một sự kiện thể thao quốc tế không phải là một sự lãng phí tiền bạc của 

một quốc gia.

Thân bài

Đoạn 1: Một số người phản đối cho rằng việc tổ chức các sự kiện thể thao quốc 

tế là đang sử dụng nguồn lực tài chính của một quốc gia một cách lãng phí. 

•  Việc xây dựng các sân vận động hiện đại, nâng cấp cơ sở hạ tầng và tăng 

cường các biện pháp an ninh có thể gây áp lực lên ngân sách của một  

quốc gia. 

•  Những nguồn tiền này nên được sử dụng để giải quyết các vấn đề cấp bách 

trong nước. 

•  Hơn nữa, tính chất nhất thời của những sự kiện này còn là một dấu hỏi lớn.

Đoạn 2: Tuy nhiên, những người ủng hộ, bao gồm cả tôi, cho rằng việc tổ chức 

các sự kiện thể thao quốc tế có thể là một khoản đầu tư có giá trị đối với một 

quốc gia. 

•  Những sự kiện này có thể thúc đẩy đáng kể ngành du lịch của một quốc gia, 

kích thích nền kinh tế địa phương và tạo ra nhiều cơ hội việc làm. 

•  Hơn nữa, việc tổ chức những sự kiện như vậy sẽ nâng cao hình ảnh toàn cầu 

của một quốc gia, khuyến khích trao đổi văn hóa và nuôi dưỡng tinh thần tự 

hào dân tộc và sự đoàn kết giữa các công dân của quốc gia đó. 

•  Cơ sở hạ tầng được phát triển cho những sự kiện này cũng có thể đóng vai 

trò là chất xúc tác cho sự phát triển đô thị và cải thiện hệ thống giao thông 

về sau.

Kết bài

Khẳng định lại quan điểm cá nhân như đã nhắc đến ở mở bài và tóm tắt ý chính 

ở thân bài.

Bài mẫu

Organizing international sporting extravaganzas like the Olympic Games or the FIFA World Cup undoubtedly 

demands enormous financial investments, prompting debates about whether this expenditure is justified. 

In this essay, we will explore both perspectives on the matter, with a focus on the argument that hosting 

international sports events is not a waste of money.

Some critics argue that hosting international sports events is a wasteful use of financial resources(1). The 

exorbitant  costs  associated  with  constructing  state-of-the-art  stadiums(2),  upgrading  infrastructure,  and 

enhancing security measures can strain a nation’s budget. These resources, they assert, could be better 

directed  to  address  pressing  domestic  issues(3)  such  as  education,  healthcare,  and  poverty  alleviation. 

Furthermore,  the  transient  nature(4)  of  these  events,  typically  spanning  only  a  few  weeks,  raises  doubts 

about whether the long-term investments can justify the short-lived excitement they bring.

This publication's user rights are given to
Mã đơn hàng: Z021241122 | Phone: 0963758090 | Email: thaykienchuyenanh@gmail.com

451 | ZIM

Nevertheless,  proponents,  including  myself,  contend  that  hosting  international  sports  events  can  be  a 

valuable  investment  for  a  country.  The  key  rationale  here  is  that    such  events  can  significantly  boost  a 

nation’s  tourism  industry,  stimulate  local  economies,  and  create  numerous  job  opportunities.  Moreover, 

hosting  such  events  enhances  a  country’s  global  image,  encourages  cultural  exchange(5),  and  fosters  a 

sense of national pride and unity(6) among its citizens. The infrastructure developed for these events can 

also serve as a catalyst for long-term urban development and transportation improvements.

In conclusion, while some argue the costs of hosting international sports events outweigh the benefits, I 

am convinced that the opposite is true. This is because these events offer a chance for global recognition 

and economic and cultural rewards.

Bài mẫu

The diagram shows the process by which pineapples are grown and processed into different products. 

Overall, this process involves both natural and man-made elements(1) and can be divided into two main 

stages: the farming of pineapples and the processing of the crop, which eventually turns into a beverage, 

a canned food, or an export(2).

First, pineapples are grown in the field with their crowns spaced 26 centimeters apart, and in a climate 

where the temperature ranges from 23 to 30 degrees Celsius. After seven months, ethylene is sprayed 

on the  plants,  after  which  they  continue  to  grow  for  an  additional  five  months  until  they  are  ready  for 

harvesting. At this stage, the pineapples should be 30 centimeters high and 2 kilograms in weight.

The process continues with the harvested pineapples being washed prior to being graded(3) according to 

their sizes. Once sorted, the smallest and medium-sized pineapples have their tops removed and their 

rinds  peeled(4).  While  the  former  pineapples  are  then  put  into  an  extractor  to  produce  juice,  the  latter 

are cut into slices or smaller chunks(5), both of which are subsequently canned. In contrast, the largest 

pineapples are simply coated in(6) wax and placed in crates before being shipped abroad.

(201 words)
